title: UI Overhaul Dynamic
description:
For [b]4.4 ✔️[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/txc9Oaf.png[/img]
[b][u][table][tr][td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/changelog/1623423360]📜 Changelog 📜[/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1665106451]Beta Version[/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2806931795]Older Versions[/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3741895210]4.3.7[/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3686813507]4.2.4[/url][/td][td][url=https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/1166/Any]Paradox Mods[/url][/td][/tr][/table]
[table][tr][td][h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1680652232]⛓️ Compatibility Patches ⛓️[/url][/h1][/td][td][h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2094085974]🏗️ Submods 🏗️[/url][/h1][/td][/tr][/table][/u]Can be used in multiplayer, even with players who doesn't use it![/b]


[h1]🛠️ Interface Modified 🛠️[/h1]
[quote]
This mod is specifically tailored towards 1920 × 1080 and 2560 × 1440, with some support for UI scaling. 3840 × 2160 users can go up to 2.0 on the UI scaling and 2560 × 1440 can go up to 1.3. Wider screens will have some small adaptations to them, like a wider outliner. Smaller resolutions than 1920 × 1080 will in most cases require UI scaling below 1.


Pretty much everything visible has had a change, but the short gist of it;
[list][*]Adapted UI to resize itself depending on user resolution.
[*]Most windows have increased height and width, to increase space for relevant content.
[*]Increased the height of most list elements.
[*]Fixes and optimizes vanilla UI wherever possible.
[*]Bigger [i]Empire Creation[/i].
[*]New [i]Planet Viewer[/i].
[*]New [i]Ship Designer[/i] that vastly increases the whole window space to allow for more ship sections, like [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=683230077]New Ship Classes[/url].
[*]New [i]Fleet Manager[/i] that hopefully increases effectiveness.
[*]In-game usable [i]Tech Tree[/i], made by: [url=https://github.com/turanar/stellaris-tech-tree]turanar[/url]. (Using the built-in web browser) - Currently maintained by [url=https://github.com/BloodStainedCrow/stellaris-tech-tree]BloodStainedCrow[/url].
[*]Bigger [i]Species Modding Window[/i].
[*]Added in keyboard icons from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2366712886]Immersive Keyboard Icons[/url].
[*]And much more...[/list]
You can also see the changes in the previews up above.
[/quote]


[h1]📜 Fonts 📜[/h1]
[quote]
This mod increases the amount of font sizes, for better text tailoring. This change will break older font mods, and requires them to be updated to match the new font IDs added in this mod.
So far, I've worked on a selection of fonts myself, and adapted the popular [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2288053878]Improved Font[/url] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198979420670/myworkshopfiles/?appid=281990]Clazex[/url], as a start. The names might be confusing, but naming creativity isn't my strongest suit.
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2830996776]Improved Text[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2830996883]Improved Font[/url][/list]
Community Font Mods:
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2008054135][简中字体]旗黑 大字号 (Simplified Chinese Font)[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2895447512]Japanese Improved Fonts[/url][/list]
[b]Use only one of them.[/b]
[/quote]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/BVCgymw.png[/img]
[url=https://discord.gg/s7AwvcghZY][img]https://i.imgur.com/FudKezw.png[/img][/url]
All support has moved to Discord.
You can find older versions of my mods and compatibility patches there.


[h1]📑 Load Order 📑[/h1]
[quote]I'd recommend putting this mod at the [b]very bottom[/b], as in [b]last[/b] in your load order.
This guarantees proper UI changes, as the launcher loads the mods from top to bottom.
Only exception is with specific instructions given with compatibility patches, or if you want a specific UI mod to overrule the changes in this one.[/quote]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/UXPt0PL.png[/img]
[h1]Thanks to everyone that has used my mod(s), and much gratitude to those special ones that have shared coin! 🙏[/h1]
[table][tr][td][url=http://paypal.me/orriedonate][img]https://i.imgur.com/LtUMrSu.png[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://www.patreon.com/orrie_mods/][img]https://i.imgur.com/SqPEYUp.png[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LhDffxK.png[/img]
[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/WpeXm2h][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Und3QN.png[/img][/url]

title: Gigastructural Engineering & More (4.4)
description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nx8tZI4.png[/img]
Do you like megastructures? I sure do! This mod aims to expand on the concept of megastructures by adding more megastructures you can build, with a wide range of effects, and sizes ranging from large space stations to system-spanning constructs.
It also adds 4 optional crises to match the power of these megastructures, complete with their own lore for you to discover, thus keeping the game challenging and interesting to the end!

[url=https://discord.gg/xUrG9wh][img]https://i.imgur.com/QnKcpuB.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.patreon.com/gigastructures][img]https://i.imgur.com/CMAGSWY.png[/img][/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kUB65he.png[/img]
- [b]45 new megastructures[/b] with a wide range of effects, including weaponized planets, microwormhole generators, stellar lasers, and system-spanning computers! The mod massively expands the endgame, adding dozens of new things to build, allowing you to shape the heavens to your will.

- [b]4 new optional crises[/b] (1 midgame, 2 endgame, 1 post-endgame) to challenge the power brought by these powerful megastructures:
- The [b]Katzenartig Imperium[/b], a hypermilitaristic empire fielding an Attack Moon as their flagship.
- [b]Aeternum[/b], an extremely ancient Fallen Empire residing on a Birch World in the galactic core.
- The [b]Compound[/b], mysterious dark matter beings linked to the EHOF, hellbent on reshaping the galaxy in their image.
- The [b]Blokkats[/b], ravenous galaxy harvesters intended to fill the role of vanilla's mysterious Hunters.
They can all be disabled at game start if you do not wish to play with them.

- [b]A menu with a custom UI, allowing you to individually select which megastructures you wish to use in the game.[/b]

- 107 custom modded Achievements that can be earned during gameplay, and can give some rewards!

- Several new origins that let you start on various ruined megastructures.

- Unique systems, containing the ruined megastructures of the empires that came before your own.

- The possibility of discovering, exploring, and exploiting the Galactic Core and its supermassive black hole.

- Improved AI that will use the megastructures as well.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/30lSou1.png[/img]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2077186491][img]https://i.imgur.com/PZsiqau.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3581504117][img]https://i.imgur.com/tYMo6Dq.png[/img][/url]
The EHOF by Kreitani has been integrated into this mod!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/H31HaST.png[/img]
[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HXW5F6S6UWESkPSh6OaxWvHwZyYAGYSuCBnCAn1B5g4/edit?usp=sharing][img]https://i.imgur.com/EiJj1nM.png[/img][/url]
The mod, as said above, adds 44 new megastructures.

Note that they might require more balancing, so feel free to point out something you think isn't right.
It is recommended to have a look at the documentation.

Please check the mod's gallery for each megastructure's description.

[b]All megastructures can be individually disabled if you do not want to use them.[/b]

The megastructures added by this mod are:
- The Event Horizon Offset Facility
- The Matrioskha Brain
- The Hawking Radiation and Accretion Emission Macro-Collector (HRAE-MC)
- The Nicoll-Dyson Beam
- The Stellar Particle Accelerator
- The Orbital Artificial Ecosystem
- The Macroengineering Testing Station
- The Neutronium Gigaforge
- The Psychic Hypersiphon
- The Dynamic Core Ignitor
- The Amospheric Purifier
- The Yggdrasil Orchid
- The Fusion Suppressor
- The Automated Stripmine
- The Kugelblitz Containment Silo
- The Star Lifter
- The Substellar Compressor
- Upgrading Ringworlds to have more habitable segments
- The Penrose Sphere
- Building multiple Ringworlds around one star
- The Military Academy
- The Orbital Elysium
- The Interstellar Habitat & Ringworld
- Attack Moons
- Behemoth Planetcrafts
- The Stellar Systemcraft
- The Macroatmospheric Stabilizer
- The Orbital Arcology
- The Planetary Computing Complex
- The Nidavellir Hyperforge
- The Crystal Megabore
- The Superatmospheric Umbegaseous Collecto-Condenser
- Ecumenopolis, Machine & Hive Ringworlds
- The Equatorial Shipyard
- The Lunar Speculorefractor
- The Hyperstructural Assembly Yard
- The Birch World
- The Alderson Disk
- The Geothermal Stabilizer
- The Quasi-Stellar Obliterator
- The Asteroid Manufactory
- The Asteroid Artillery
- The Planetary Dockyard/Planetary Drive Yards/Planetary Defense Nexus
- The Psionic Beacon
- The Behemoth Assembly Plant
- The Maginot World

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oRhF967.png[/img]
Q: I wanna add something to the mod!
A: If you'd like something you made to be in this mod, simply friend me and we can discuss it!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QdkRHe4.png[/img]
Overwrites the "habitable_structure" scripted_trigger, so might mess with some mods that also overwrite it. Should still work mostly fine.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1636492142]Patch to fix the issue[/url]

Mods that add new resources will not display them properly in the topbar.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1595876588]Patch to fix the issue[/url]

Real Space System Scale will cause problems with the models, such as clipping or exploded ringworlds.

Overwrites vanilla megas to unlock the megastructure limits.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2381398719]No Katzenartig Imperium Submod[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p2yxnZS.png[/img]
Currently available in: English, Russian (by Геракл) & Chinese (by LunarTraveller & team). If you wish to translate, please contact me directly.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0C4XSOA.png[/img]
[b]A LIST OF FULL CREDITS IS AVAILABLE ON THE DISCORD! (with mod links)[/b]
Kreitani: Modelling, EHOF, major bugfixing, rewriting the mod
Yanzihko: Steam preview pictures & description headers
NHunter: Interstellar, Gas Giant, Behemoth & Great Ringworld origins, bunch of techs
Nikkle: For creating the ringworld cluster mod which helped me understand how models work
Italian Noises: Some ship models used in the mod, taken from  the wonderful [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1918294643]Stellar-Naval Ship Art Pack[/url]
Djohaal: Substellar Compressor asset & idea
Sam: Planetary Computer asset & idea
Sithalo: Ecumenopolis Ringworld
Chirumiru: Sounds for Ecumenopolis Ringworld
James Fire: Orbital Arcology, Military Academy, Documentation, overall being useful
AlphaAsh: Equatorial Shipyard idea and planet view art
Thauma: Birch World jobs and districts
Twinks315: Birch World model
AryxErin: Machine ship assets for megastructures
Annatar: Hyperquasar assets
SwasChan: New logo
Kharalos: Flat Planet origin
Uethredyes: Skeletor portraits
TTFTCUTS & Arheo: 3D Blokkat Portraits, models and icons for the planetary harvester.
Garyx: Ascendant Shipset (Aeternite ships)
ECHO: Networked AI Shipset (old Blokkat ships)
MadamLava: New Blokkat ship models
Aerolfos: Maginot World
Robican: Revived Meopa portrait (from Cyborg Portraits)
EaW Team: Various textures for Faust

LORE CREDITS:
_Rose: Ezicanian lore
Aphunphi: Solakian lore
Lemonfell: Laurandar lore
CalamityTime: Corrona & Lyuinita lore
Artemis: Aeternum lore
Max.lm & Victoneux: Parts of Katzen lore
Omniscient: Compound lore


[url=https://discord.gg/bHVez2C][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Und3QN.png[/img][/url]

Have fun building Gigastructures, and don't forget to rate!

[h1]The Steam comments have been disabled due to them being basically pointless as we very rarely respond to them. Please join the Discord if you want to give feedback, report bugs and ask questions, it will be far more efficient for both you and us.[/h1]

[url=https://discord.gg/xUrG9wh][img]https://i.imgur.com/QnKcpuB.png[/img][/url]

description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]
[h1]Stellaris: 4.4.*[/h1]
[h1]Not Achievement Friendly[/h1]
[h1][url=https://discord.gg/qHuWBhaZpg]PD Discord Server[/url][/h1]

[h2]Other Planetary Diversity Mods[/h2]

This mod adds new artwork for habitable planets to the game.

The mod uses events to change the existing planets after the game starts and does not add more planets to a game.

[h1]Terraforming[/h1]
You can only use the Vanilla terraforming link, but you can choose the planet portrait once the process is complete. To terraform Rare Worlds, you need the World Shaper perk. Additionally, the option to change portraits without changing the planet class thereby terraforms the planet to the same class.

[h1]Climate Based Gaia Worlds[/h1]
[h3]Requires: World Shaper Ascension Perk[/h3]
PD divides Gaia worlds into three climate-specific types. Each type offers 100% habitability within its climate group and 50% across other groups. Terraforming between these three climates is possible. Additionally, the 'World Shaper Project' decision lets you grant non-Gaia worlds the same bonuses as Gaia worlds, enabling you to reap Gaia benefits without needing the same planetary portrait everywhere.

[h1]Uncommon, Rare, and Gaia Buildings[/h1]
Uncommon, Rare, and Gaia Worlds have special bonuses and buildings. If you start on an Uncommon World, you gain nearby terraforming candidates of the type. While you can only have one active, you can have up to three rare buildings that start weaker but upgrade as you gain more tech. This applies to all the buildings. If a race cannot use said buildings, they don't get them (i.e., non-food races don't gain access to the food buildings).

[h1]Uncommon Worlds[/h1]
[h3]Superhabitable Types[/h3]
Wet, Dry, Cold
These worlds have more space and are ideal for life to evolve, but the high gravity makes it harder for other races to live here.
[h3]Karst Types[/h3]
Wet, Dry, Cold
These planets have a lower district count but have high mining opportunities.
[h3]Tidally-Locked Types[/h3]
Wet, Dry, Cold
These planets have fewer total districts but improved food and energy generation.

[h1]Rare + Regular Worlds[/h1]
Although spawning for these rare planet classes is limited, the World Shaper Ascension Perk allows you to terraform any planet into a rare class. Regular worlds alter the planet's appearance and provide a modifier.

[h2]Wet Worlds[/h2]
[h3]Continental Types[/h3]
Regular: Retinal, Forest, Lake, Tepid, Mushroom, Sakura, Moss, Marsh, Carotene
Rares: Megaflora, Petrified Woods
[h3]Ocean Types[/h3]
Regular: Cascadian, Crag, Swamp, Fog, Kelp, Pink Algae, Columnar, Tidepool, Barnacle
Rares: Reef, Archipelago
[h3]Tropical Types[/h3]
Regular: Atoll, Mangrove, Tepui, Cenote, Fungal, Aerial, Lilypad, Obsidian, Thunderstorm
Rares: Geothermal, Biolumen

[h2]Dry Worlds[/h2]
[h3]Desert Types[/h3]
Regular: Dune, Oasis, Outback, Coastal, Fungi, Ironsand, Cactus, Dust, Sodalite
Rares: Salt, Aquifer
[h3]Arid Types[/h3]
Regular: - Mesa, Fog Desert, Mediterranean, Badlands, Succulent, Striped, Amethyst
Rares: Primal, Coral
[h3]Savannah Types[/h3]
Regular: Steppe, Prairie, Veld, Semi-Arid, Aspen, Sandstone, Turquoise, Calcite, Monsoon, Silvergrass
Rares: Sinkhole, Supercontinent

[h2]Cold Worlds[/h2]
[h3]Arctic Types[/h3]
Regular: - Frigid, Glacial, Antarctic, Aeolian, Ice Spike, Crevasse, Ice Dunes, Ferrosprings, Supraglacial Lakes
Rares: Storm, Iceberg
[h3]Tundra Types[/h3]
Regular: - Bog, Mycelium, Mud, Basalt, Tuya, Cryovolcano, Treeline, Peatland, Travertine
Rares: Cryoflora, Lichen
[h3]Alpine Types[/h3]
Regular: - Boreal, Snow, Highland, Dune Forest, Fjord, Blossom, Taiga, Craton, Ravine
Rares: Glaciovolcanic, Lanthanide

[h2]Volcanic Worlds[/h2]
Regular: Ash World

[h1]Uninhabitable Planets[/h1]
These are visual only and add a deposit to the planet. Otherwise, they are the same as their parent class.
Hothouse World, Diamond World, Chthonian World, Hot Gas Giant, Cold Gas Giant, Subglacial World, Volcanic World, Ethane Ocean, Hydrocarbon World, Cloudless Gas Giant, Carbon World, Iron World

[h1]Domed Colonies[/h1]
[h3]Requires: Domed Habitation Tech[/h3]
Domed Colonies can only be established on vanilla or uncommon barren terraforming candidates to speed up their colonization. Functioning like standard colonies but with limited district size to reflect their specialized infrastructure, they are constructed through the megastructure interface or by right-clicking a planet with a construction ship. Like all terraforming candidates, they can be terraformed into any standard planet type once you have the Climate Restoration and Ecological Adaptation technologies.

[h1]Planetary Outposts[/h1]
[h3]Requires: Domed Habitation Tech[/h3]
Planetary Outposts are non-colonizable structures built using planetary decisions on colonies. They must link to an uninhabitable planet in the same solar system with the 'Domed Base' modifier. These outposts can only be constructed in systems that contain at least one habitable planet. While not colonies, outposts generate jobs based on the capital level of the linked colony—but only if the outpost planet has an 'Intrasolar Network Hub' deposit. Moon Bases, a type of outpost, allow you to choose which jobs they provide. You can change the job they provide via a decision on the moon itself.

[h1]Interplanetary Settlers - Origin[/h1]
[h3]Random & Sol Versions[/h3]
This origin focuses on Domed Colonies and Planetary Outputs. You begin with one of each in your starting system and have the technology to produce more from the start of the game.

[h1]Mars and Venus Artwork[/h1]
Mars and Venus have five custom portraits depending on whether the planet is uncolonized, a domed colony, wet, dry, or cold.

[h1]Click this link for the [url=https://discord.gg/qHuWBhaZpg]PD Discord Server[/url]. Please go there for FAQs, questions, comments, or bug reports.[/h1]
[h3] I'm no longer allowing comments on this workshop item due to the numerous rude messages and people not reading the mod description. Sorry to anyone without access to Discord.[/h3]

Do not use Planetary Diversity's original art without permission. Do NOT put PD in a merged Mod Pack without permission (collections are encouraged). All art is done by the amazing [url=https://www.deviantart.com/hazpainting]HazPainting[/url]!

[b]Real Space v 4.0.10[/b] 

[b]This version is compatible with patch 4.4.6 Pegasus.[/b]

[table]
[tr]
[th][url=boosty.to/annatar108] [img]https://imgur.com/ZEBNNJB.png[/img][/url][/th]

[/tr]
[/table]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EjzuguR.png[/img]

This mod does not fundamentally change the game mechanics, creating the scenery for Stellaris more diverse and atmospheric.
 
So, there is a list of what the mod performs:

[img]https://imgur.com/orM7mya.png[/img]

[h1]New stellar classes were added:[/h1]
[list]
[*]O Class – the most bright and rare blue stars;
[*]L Class – cold brown dwarfs;
[*]D Class – white dwarf, star remains;
[*][strike]T Class – dim methane dwarfs (added as planets, because there is no sense in making the stars out of them)[/strike];
[*]Y Class – intermediate step between the star and the gas giant (now it's a star);
[*]С Class – carbon stars;
[*]S Class – zirconium stars; 
[*]W Class – mysterious Wolf-Rayet stars (4 nebula types);
[*]Nova – is a close binary system with a flared white dwarf after absorption of the companion star substance (2 types);
[*]Collapsar – exploded star, the final stage of the evolution of the star (replacement of the Supernova);
[*]Protostar – is the star in the formation stage;
[*]Luminous Blue Variable – is a bright, unstable blue hypergiant with a diffuse nebula (3 nebula types)
[*]T Tauri - very young stars with a protoplanetary disc (3 types);
[*]Herbig Star - very young bright stars with a protoplanetary disc;
[*]Planetary Nebula - systems with clouds of ionized gas, remnants of deceased stars (3 types);
[*]Magnetar - neutron star with a very strong magnetic field.
[*]Microquasar - smaller version of the quasar (2 types).
[*]FUor - very hot young star with a protoplanetary disk.

[/list]

[h1]New stellar types were added:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Dwarfs
[*]Regular stars
[*]Giants
[*]Supergiants
[*]Hypergiants
[/list]

[img]https://imgur.com/DCx0Z8l.png[/img]

[list]
[*]More than 100 variations of binary, ternary and pair systems with their icons.;
[*]The structure of the systems was changed in such a way that the orbits of the planets looked more realistic. That is, the size of the orbits increases proportionally with distance from the central luminary;
[*]Randomly, small dust clouds can appear in the systems;
[*]Many dust clouds in the systems which are in the zone of the nebula;
[*]132 real star systems, adjacent to the Sun were added. (No more blue Betelgeuse, special stuff for roleplayers!) Now 3 types of Sol Sector to choose from: Large (132 stars), Medium (82 stars) and Small (57 stars);
[*]In Sol Sector, several civilizations of different levels of development may appear.
[/list]

[h1]Added 3 new starting systems, which you can choose when creating a race:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Regor system - is a system with a Wolf-Rayet star, also known as Gamma Velorum;
[*]GK Persei system - is a system with a Nova;
[*]Eta Carinae system - is a system with a Luminous Blue Variable.
[/list]

[img]https://imgur.com/98v7ZIl.png[/img]

50 new skins for gas planets were added (and red gas giants are here too!)

Also I wanted to make generated galaxy map as a space sector or cluster-shaped form, but because of some technical moments and game restrictions it will be better to develop it as a standalone mod.

[img]https://imgur.com/3GAzhfM.png[/img]

The scaling system after version 3.4 is a separate submode!

[img]https://imgur.com/mbjfaEH.png[/img]

[url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2812925242]Chines[/url]
[url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2784541849]Thai[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vREipmy.png[/img]

[b]Before reporting an error, make sure that the culprit is not another mod. To avoid compatibility problems, it is recommended to move all RS mods to the very bottom of the list of mods in the launcher. At the same time, pay attention that the RS main mode should be above the submods.[/b]

[h1]Join the Real Space Mod group to discuss the project![/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/realspacemod

This mod does not support achievements.

[b]This is a very voluminous mod, it affects a lot of things and that's why this mod inevitably has a lot of compatibility problems. It should be very easy to use this mod with others mods.[/b]

ПС: Для русскоязычных игроков. Если вы пользуетесь модом на перевод названий и имен [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=699707943]Russian Names Extended by Annatar[/url] или аналогичным от [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2123697232]Rindera[/url], то настоятельно рекомендую вам поставить патч [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=937296595&searchtext=russian+names]Russian Names - Real Space Patch[/url] для того, что бы все названия реальных звезд были переведены на русский и не дублировались.

Stellaris is a wonderful game. I will continue to make modifications and compatibility to them, I like it. But all this takes a lot of time and effort, so any, even the smallest donation will motivate me to work in this direction even more. In any case, I will continue and it will be a game of our dreams!

[img]https://imgur.com/8hXVs7X.png[/img]

[b]My work is completely dependent on your donations. I have a lot of plans, friends, but they will be realized only thanks to you.[/b]

[i]As of late, Patreon no longer works for me. I can only get your help through [url=boosty.to/annatar108]Boosty[/url] and am switching to the new support model. You can now choose which project to support. I will be able to start upgrading as soon as we raise the necessary amount. The good news is that updates will appear immediately on Steam and will be available to everyone.[/i]

Before reporting an error, make sure that the culprit is not another mod. To avoid compatibility problems, it is recommended to move all RS mods to the very bottom of the list of mods in the launcher. At the same time, pay attention that the RS main mode should be above the submods.

Join the Real Space Mod group to discuss the project!
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/realspacemod

This mod does not support achievements.

This is a very voluminous mod, it affects a lot of things and that's why this mod inevitably has a lot of compatibility problems. It should be very easy to use this mod with others mods.

In any case, I will continue and it will be a game of our dreams!

My work is completely dependent on your donations. I have a lot of plans, friends, but they will be realized only thanks to you.

title: NSC3

[img=https://i.imgur.com/RRb9Rcw.png]

[img=https://i.imgur.com/nLNkcBX.png]
[h1][b]Having trouble with NSC? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/683230077/759555096795282832/]Click here for troubleshooting steps.[/url][/b][/h1]



[img=https://i.imgur.com/KaE3Jnl.png]
[h1][b]June 28, 2026 - Season 1 - Update 26 (Mod Version 1.0.27)
[i]New Save Game is [u]Not Required[/u][/i][/b][/h1]

[h1][b]New & Updated Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed all tech requirements from all NSC Exploration aux components - they are all now available at game start.
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where a Bioship Explorer design could not be saved due to lack of access to a combat computer.

[*]Fixed a bug where the Bioship Explorer did not have access to the NSC Exploration aux components.

[*]Fixed a bug where Nomads couldn't use the Hyperlane Creation/Deletion feature.

[*]Fixed a bug where the Bioship Explorer and Dreadnought had the same upkeep as mechanical ships, rather than the food upkeep.

[*]Fixed a bug where most of the NSC starbase buildings and modules were not properly applying planetary bonuses and modifiers, and some were not buildable at all.

[*]Fixed a bug where the Nightclub and Space Foundry starbase buildings were able to be built on Arkships.

[*]Fixed a bug where Bioship empires did not have access to the techs to unlock Explorer levels 2, 3, and 4.
[/list]



[img=https://i.imgur.com/LeHB0xY.png]
[h1][b]June 27, 2026 - Season 1 - Update 26 (Mod Version 1.0.26)
[i]New Save Game is [u]Highly Recommended[/u][/i][/b][/h1]

[h1][b]New & Updated Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated the mod for Stellaris 4.4.

[*]Added 2 new NSC classes for the Bioships - a "Ravager" Dreadnought class and a "Sentinel" Explorer class. (These are the only 2 classes we are planning to add to the Bioships).

[*]Increased the fleet command limit from 1000 to 8000, to allow for larger fleets after the 4.3 fleet capacity increase.

[*]Increased the maximum empire fleet capacity from 9,999 to 99,999, to allow for larger fleets after the 4.3 fleet capacity increase.

[*]Reduced the build time for the Solar Stronghold from 2500 days to the same 360 days that all other starbase levels are set to.

[*]Removed the Destroyer's Escort Carrier research upgrade and changed the Escort Carrier sections to automatically unlock upon researching Cruisers, to avoid long waits for RNG to pop up the tech.

[*]Due to ongoing bugs and issues, the NSC Advanced Ship Behaviors have been removed from the mod. As a replacement, we highly recommend the Spacefleet Tactica mod, which is significantly more advanced than the NSC behaviors were. You can subscribe to that mod here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3696204283

[*]Temporarily removed the Fleet Mothball feature until its code can be rewritten to eliminate the bugs.

[*]Added special coding to the Flagship which will prevent it from being instantly destroyed when using Emergency FTL (It can still be destroyed by the Emergency FTL damage effect if the damage is higher than the ship's remaining HP).

[*]Hyperlane Generators & Removers will no longer count towards the megastructure limit.
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the Nemesis ships still had the old pre-4.3 fleet capacity numbers.

[*]Fixed a bug where the tooltip for the Eternal Vigilance perk still referenced the starbase defense platform policy, which was removed in vanilla in 4.3.

[*]Fixed a bug where Frigates were not able to access Level 6 and higher reactors.

[*]Fixed a bug where the damage multipliers on the Minuteman and Harpoon torpedoes were set much too high (they were still on pre-4.3 numbers).

[*]Fixed a bug where colony and construction ships were not getting access to cloaking devices as they were intended to in a previous NSC update.

[*]Fixed a couple of minor typos/bugs with the NSC overwrite of the Eternal Vigilance ascension perk.
[/list]


[h1][b]Mod Backend/Coding Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Moved all of the NSC ship classes to its own nsc_ship_sizes file. (We still overwrite the vanilla 00_ship_sizes file to change necessary things on vanilla classes)

[*]Added scripted trigger [b]is_nsc_activated = { always = yes }[/b] to the mod to help with compatibility with other mods. (common/scripted_triggers/nsc_scripted_triggers.txt)
[/list]



[img=https://i.imgur.com/MzgqfMN.png]
If you don't wish to use the Steam workshop for NSC3, you can download it directly from the NSC3 Github here:  https://github.com/CaptainX3/NSC3-Mod/releases
Manual installation instructions are on the download page. You can also find all previous releases of the mod there (Starting from the first release of NSC2 Season 8).


[img=https://i.imgur.com/N3qXEN7.png]
We have uploaded the previous version of NSC to the workshop for those who wish to continue their save games before upgrading to this new version. Please note that this is only updated when a major update is released for NSC (that requires a new save game). To subscribe to the Previous Version, click here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2386308448


[img=https://i.imgur.com/iWWYbR5.png]
You can join our server and chat directly with the NSC devs and many other players and modders, or post ideas and suggestions for us! [u]Over 90% of the new content added to the mod comes directly from our Discord users![/u] Simply head to the link below to join.

Join the Official NSC Discord: https://discord.gg/8yTv5MR9H3




[h3][i]Copyright 2026 - This item is not authorized for posting on Steam except under the Steam account named CaptainX3. It is also not authorized to be posted on any other website EXCEPT the official NSC3 Github page. Copies of this mod found other than on this exact page or on the NSC3 Github page are stolen and unauthorized. All Rights Reserved.[/i][/h3]

title: More Events Mod
description:
[h1]COMPATIBLE with Stellaris 4.4.*[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3743853605]Link to 4.3 version[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3087170862]Link to Standalone Portrait Mod[/url]

Are you looking for more action and interesting events to show up while you are doing your day to day enslaving and conquering business? If, like us, you find the mid to late game a little lacking of interesting diversion, then you have come to the right place. This mod adds new anomalies and events to your game, focusing on spicing up the game after exploration has slowed down.

Note: There have been some slight changes to the galactic_features_events.txt

[h1]ACHIEVEMENTS WILL BE DISABLED WHEN USING THIS MOD[/h1]

This mod will be constantly updated with new content for your game. All events are designed to be balanced with the events in the vanilla game.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZRW5TDjv/trenner-1.png[/img]

[h1]Languages[/h1]
[list]
[*]English
[*]externally managed translation submods : 
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2810284852]Russian[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2713034866]Italian[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2606860175]Japanese[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177]French[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2131014154]Chinese[/url] / [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3580896305]Chinese 2[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3536173129]Spanish[/url] / [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3694559617]Spanish 2[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3667495300]German[/url]
[/list]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZRW5TDjv/trenner-1.png[/img]

[h1]Mod Content[/h1]
Anomalies, Events and Archaeological sites to add more variety to your gaming expierience. Additionally there are various new species portraits (used for our factions) which are also accessable for custom empires, but they will not spawn as randomly generated empires.
Also this mod adds deactivatable planetary shield graphics as well as an also deactivatable alternative version of the shieldworld planets.

[url=http://more-events-mod.wikidot.com/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/0N2QPFcS/wiki-logo-150-2.png[/img][/url]
Our Wiki is still under construction. Everyone is welcome to add info to it they would expect to see there.	

[b][h3]Fun with numbers:[/h3]
Anomalies:[/b] 72 with a total of 130 Outcomes (not counting potential branching events after the anomaly finisher)
[b]Archaeological sites:[/b] 28
[b]Astral Rifts:[/b] 1
[b]Primitive related events:[/b] 18
[b]Colony level events:[/b] 13
[b]Country level events:[/b] 17
[b]Special system focussed events:[/b] 8
[b]Origins:[/b] 5
[list]
[*]E.D.E.N. Protocol
[*]Ceaseless Gaze
[*]Ancestors' Grudge
[*]Ancestors' Automata
[*]Hive's Hoard
[/list]
[b]Highimpact Questlines and Crises:[/b] 12
[list]
[*]Elusive Carcosa
[*]Legacy of the Carcharorion
[*]Food Constructor
[*]Lost Emperor
[*]Descended Ascendant
[*]Aevum
[*]Extinct Abductors
[*]The Last Orila

[*]Return of the Sadrell
[*]Surveyor Probe
[*]Broken Clock
[*]Vazuran Menace
[/list]

If there are [b]ARTISTS[/b] out there who are able to produce event pics with a quality and style matching that of Paradox´s pics and would like to support our work we would love to use their artwork in this mod.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZRW5TDjv/trenner-1.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Reports[/h1]
You found a bug during your game session? Please, post it in the Bug report discussion thread so we can squish it in the next version. And if you could give us some hints on how to reproduce it, it would be also very helpful.

[b][h1]FAQ[/h1]
Q: Is this or that event from your mod?
A: First, open your console while the event window is still there. Then type in "debugtooltip" and press enter, then close the console. Now check the tooltip when hovering your mouse over one of the event's options. It displays the event_id among other information. All of our event_ids start mit "mem_". If there's no "mem_" it's not from us.

Q: I hate these f*****g Vazurans! They are the worst crisis ever and it makes me disable this s****y mod! How do I make them go away forever!?!
A: The Vazuran Menace can be completely disabled by unselecting the Vazuran Menace precursor button in the pregame selection.

Q: Can I activate this mod in a running save game?
A: Yes you can, but some events won´t appear in that case, as they are set at game start. Aside from this there should be no issues.

[h1]Compatches[/h1]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2993881965]Real Space System Scale/Planetary Shields Compatch 2.0[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3709631304]Tech Tier Numbers Patch[/url]
[/list]
[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/bHVez2C][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Und3QN.png[/img][/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZRW5TDjv/trenner-1.png[/img]

[b][h1]Donations[/h1][/b]
If you want to further support our work on improving the mod by adding additional art assets, please leave us a little donation. The page is set up to accept the lowest possible amount in my currency. Whatever you can spare, you'll have our thanks for it. You also won't be throwing your money into the aether either, as we have clear goals on what to do next with donated funds - visible on that page. See our latest addition (Orila, Vazuran and Neochadamus portraits) to get an idea of the quality you can expect. In the end you'll support both the mod and the artist, with whom we plan to keep on colaborating.

The Orila (+ their expansion), Vazuran and Neochadamus (paragon) portraits were funded by us. At this point we have to make a cut however as our personal funds for this project are limited as well.

Anything further will need your support. Next we want to add new species portraits for the different Broken Clock aliens (devouring swarm molluscoids, determined exterminator robots, fanatic purifier lithoids which are also meant to be available for the player species. And then there is still more we'd like to add.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/C5RLxfKM/korolev-workshop-2.png[/img]

[b]Finished and implemented:[/b][list]
[*]Neochadamus Paragon Portrait
[*]Orila Species Portrait with outfits and hologram paragon portrait variation
[*]Vazuran Species Portrait
[*]Neochadamus Portrait expansion for Species Portrait *
[*]Overlord Trailer Emperor Paragon Portrait *
[*]Orila Expansion (fitting robot portrait, hologram version for normal portraits, cybernetic variation)
[*]Broken Clock molluscoid devouring swarm Species Portrait *
[*]Broken Clock machine terminators Species Portrait *
[*]Broken Clock lithoid purifier Species Portrait *
[*]Rebel Yell Event - female Foxkin Paragon *
[*]Sadrell/Broken Clock 4 - Better Dwarven Species Portrait - better beards and hairstyles, no tattoos, new female face, more militaristic armored clothing *
[/list]
[b]Currently worked on:[/b][list]
[*]Voggo the Great - Ancient Frog Paragon
[/list]
[b]Funded and next on the plan:[/b][list]
[*]Master Runesmith Dranir - Dwarven Paragon
[*]Ascended Neochadamus Paragon
[/list]
[b]Planned, not yet funded:[/b][list]
[/list]
* funded through donations

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Ghjg4chF/Portrait-collage-2.png[/img]

[url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/yVw7w7qa9L][img]https://i.postimg.cc/DZPV2KC0/bmac.jpg[/img][/url]

title: Guilli's Planet Modifiers and Features
description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/v0c7ibh.png[/img]
[h1]Guilli's Planet Modifiers[/h1]
For version 4.4+ of the game. 


Goes well with my: 
Guilli's Technologies mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1793768254&tscn=1747825624
Guilli's Exploration and Expansion mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2802824108
 
4.3 version: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3744516949
-----

A big content expansion mod focusing on Planetary Modifiers. With hundreds of modifiers and lots of content that interacts with them. 
 
DLC's not required though some features are DLC locked!
Compatible with most mods. Special compatibility has been built in for the bigger mods, such as Planetary Diversity, Gigastructures, Real Space. 

 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dBdEAcF.png[/img]
[h1]List of features[/h1]
 
[h1]General[/h1]
	· Custom code engine that runs after game start ensuring maximum mod compatibility and ensures during the gameplan there is very little performance impact. 
	· Custom Start Manu letting you tweak a lot of settings or even turn of features entirely!
	· Custom planet modifier border colours.
 
[h1]Over 400 new Planet Modifiers have been added. [/h1]
	· Most are spawned during the game start. 
	· Normal planet modifiers that provide bonuses or maluses. 
	· Uninhabitable planet modifiers for flavour and story.
	· Precursor planet modifiers, powerful story elements left behind by ancient empires long gone.
	· Fallen Empire planet modifiers, elder empires have not left their planets untouched.
	· Terraforming planet modifiers, after terraforming no planet is the same and gain unique features.
	· Habitat planet modifiers, special construction modifiers unlocked by habitat decisions.
	· Ringworld Planet modifiers, special construction modifiers unlocked by ringworld decisions.
	· Machine world modifiers, unique planet modifiers for machine worlds.
	· Crisis planet modifiers, when crisis factions bomb or take over planets they can leave behind traces of their horror. 
 
[h1]Planet Features and blockers[/h1]
	· Hundreds of custom features matching planet modifiers that spawn alongside them. 
	· Tons of new blockers for you to clear.
	· Special precursor and archaeology features.
 
[h1]Terraforming improvements[/h1]
	· Terraforming cleans up planet modifiers and has a chance to roll new positive ones.
	· Most bad negative modifiers will be removed (where it makes sense)
	· Precursor modifiers will NOT be removed.
	· Wondrous Planet features will not be removed. 
	· The newly terraformed planet has a chance to roll new flavour or positive modifiers. Flavour modifiers have a grey border and are just there for story/lore or roleplay.
	· Turning a planet into a Machine World will remove most modifiers and roll unique machine world modifiers except for precursor modifiers. 
 
[h1]New planetary decisions have been added[/h1]
	· Decisions to clear bad planet modifiers or "fix" planetary problem modifiers.
	· Decisions to add habitat infrastructure based on the planet the habitat is orbiting around.
	· Decisions to build additional infrastructure on ringworlds.
	· Decision to specialise machine worlds.
	· And more!
 
[h1]Tons of story events[/h1]
	· Capital world events.
	· Events for new colonies based on planet modifiers and features.
	· Unique leviathan "The living Planet" with a special reward. Leviathan DLC required for this to show up! 
	· And more!
 
[h1]New Anomalies and exploration events[/h1]
	· 4 new anomalies.
	· Tons of survey and exploration events with choices based on your empire makeup.
	· Numerous custom and rare rewards to for these events such as ships, components, techs, traits, and more...
	· With lots of decisions allowing for maximum roleplaying potential!
	· Planets with interesting features can spawn terraforming candidate modifiers. Even frozen and molten worlds will be able to be terraformed this way.
 
[h1]New policy: survey expeditions[/h1]
	· Choose between three exploration survey options to determine how fast you survey. The faster you survey; the less exploration rewards you get. Initial policy is set by ethics choices. AI can and will adjust this policy based on their situation. E.g.; Militarists empires will start exploring faster if they meet another empire. 
 
[h1]Tons of new Precursor Dig Sites[/h1]
	· When discovering a precursor world, there's a chance a precursor dig site appears. Unravelling these dig sites have a potential to reward you with very powerful precursor rewards such as ships, techs, empire modifiers and even relics!
 
[h1]Precursor Discoveries (technologies)[/h1]
	· Lots of custom unique precursor technologies were added with their own technology colour. These are very powerful discoveries. 
	· Precursor home systems have been spiced up and spawn with an ancient, damaged Precursor Mega Shipyard.
 
[h1]29 new relics[/h1]
	· 3 special ones can be found during exploration
	· 26 precursor relics found from special precursor dig sites
 
[h1]Relic War Goals[/h1]
	· Relic casus belli and war goals for every relic (including base game relics!)
	· The AI really likes relics and will go to war for them. Some AI's will become more aggressive in wanting relics for every relic they have. 
	· Casus belli are unlocked if you neighbour an empire that has a relic and have enough intel (50)
	 
[h1]Espionage[/h1]
	· Steal Relic espionage operation. Hold the greatest heist the galaxy has ever seen and steal another empire's relic with potentially dire consequences if you're caught! The AI can do this to the player but it is very rare and they must really dislike you. 
 
[h1]Custom Relic map[/h1]
	· A map mode that displays who has relics and how many (if you have enough intel). 
	 
[h1]Minor Artifacts  (requires Ancient Relics DLC)[/h1]
	· Reverse Engineer minor artifacts action has been modified to provide more random rewards. Added over 100 new possible discoveries such as techs and unlocks.
	· Several custom armies have been added that you can unlock through exploration. They cost Minor Artifacts to build. 
	· Several modded rewards have a Minor Relic cost if you have the Ancient Relics DLC. A normal cost if you don’t.
	· Several powerful edicts are unlocked after researching the reverse engineer minor artifacts technology.
 
[h1]Mini-Megastructures[/h1]
	· 4 minor megastructures were added. They spawn broken across the galaxy. Repairing them isn't too expensive and gives minor empire bonuses. 
 
[h1]Wondrous Planets[/h1]
	· Some planets can become wondrous planets and gain a unique and powerful planetary feature.
 
[h1]Other stuff:[/h1]
	· Shielded world graphics for specific planet modifiers.
	· Solar systems are spiced up with debris in precursor systems.
	· A unique shipyard star model for precursor shipyards modifier (not a megastructure).
	· Unique planetary graphics for some precursor modifiers.
	· Sol (if populated by humans) has the James Webb Telescope.
	· Mars has an old friend for you to find.
	 
 
 [b]Special thanks to everyone for helping out and providing feedback![/b]


 [b]French translation pack [/b]: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177


[h1]Follow me on bluesky for updates![/h1]
[url=https://bsky.app/profile/tommyteunckens.bsky.social][/url]
 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zNzvgSf.png[/img]
[h1]Support my time[/h1]
Hello, if you like what I do and wish to thank me for my time working on this mod you can do so by donating a few dollars to help me pay the bills :). Any support is greatly appreciated! Thank you.

[url=https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=42EJN3CEG8TLY] [img]http://i.imgur.com/DR3G8dK.png[/img] [/url]

title: ! Reworked Advanced Ascension
description:
[img=https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/15267081576015839244/924E43B8BC42686D0281809F3CFD8BE3BDB35386/]
[h1][b]适配群星4.4
本MOD的目标是为原版基础飞升添加新的二段进阶飞升
30个新增进阶飞升[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1199002146/5040080777785256060/]详细介绍[/url]
飞升槽上限提升至24，需要[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1199002146]UOD系列[/url]或[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2438313459]工整传统[/url]提供UI支持
本MOD后续开发已由[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/ShinazugawaKasako/myworkshopfiles/]大家の小傘[/url]接管
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2881430068]旧版备份[/url]只在MOD大更新时会同步
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1414213153]经典版[/url](不要共用)，前作者的东西

如果你需要超过24个飞升槽，看看这些mod【[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2458656056]256[/url]/[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2466510521]128[/url]/[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2458655721]64[/url]/[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2466511041]48[/url]】
[/b][/h1]
[i]请注意，任何修改飞升槽上限的MOD都将覆盖本MOD对飞升槽上限的改动。[/i]

[h1][b]其他内容：[/b][/h1]
[h2]①define改动：基础跃迁CD为200天(与原版一致)，基础跃迁预热10天
②超空间航速略微提升
③添加额外的跃迁惩罚，相对原版，跃迁后舰队更为脆弱一些
④循环飞升槽法令，最多15次
[/h2]


[h1][b]未来计划：
继续添加二段飞升与分支选择
[/b][/h1]


[h1][b]兼容性：[/b][/h1]
[h2]①大部分飞升MOD和传统类MOD都兼容
②只添加飞升上限，不改动UI，所以理论上兼容所有UI类MOD
③你需要[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1199002146]UOD系列[/url]或[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2438313459]工整传统[/url]提供UI支持解锁新的飞升槽
④改动了define中的默认跃迁CD(与原版一致200天)，超空间速度为原版2倍，如果这些设置有变动，本MOD可能会出现问题
⑤无法建造分公司可以用[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2409276081]伞の泛用规则兼容[/url]
⑥【工整传统】激活时禁用飞升循环，工整传统有自己的。
[/h2]


[h1][b]排序：[/b][/h1]
[h2]任意位置，建议往后排[/h2]


[h1][b]详细功能图鉴(右键新标签打开)：[/b][/h1]

title: Machine Shipset
description:
The Automated Dreadnought guardian is a beautiful ship. Which makes it a shame that it's one of a kind and that there aren't many other ships in its style.
Until now!

[h1] Behold machine ships, a fully sectioned shipset! [/h1]

Machine Ships adds a new shipset in the stellaris game style. Rather than pull from some movie series or game, these ships are designed with the stellaris lore and style in mind. The shipset is accessable from the empire creation ship menu screen. It contains high quality models and ships of all kinds, including the following:

  -Corvettes
  -Destroyers
  -Cruisers
  -Battleships
  -Titans
  -Juggernaut
  -Colossus
  -Science vessel
  -Stations
  -Construction ships
  -[b]Megastructures! [/b]
  -Even a city set by PSIONIC(creator of United Fleet)


Unlike most other shipset mods on the workshop, Machine Ships is [b] FULLY SECTIONED[/b] meaning that all of the ship classes are made of different section and module variants. A large update that overhauls all of the models is on its way.
Don't forget to upvote/favourite! It's the easiest way to support me as a mod creator as it provides the motivation to create. Less than 3% of the mod's subs vote for it positively which does get depressing.

[h1] Frequently Asked Questions [/h1]

[b] Achievements? [/b]
No. 

[b] Does the mod support NSC? [/b]
Partially! NSC support is currently iffy as I need to do some fixes (they changed everything :p)

[b] Does the mod work with Downscaled Ships, Real Space System Scale or Aesthetic Cinematic Gameplay? [/b]
Yes, there is a patch on my workshop page.

[b] Does the mod work with Realistic ships? [/b]
Yep, compatibility is inbuilt.

[b] Why is the dyson sphere so garbage? [/b]
You tell me.

[b] Habitats appear black [/b]
I know - I have not been able to replicate it on my end at all and thus cannot fix it.

Models by AryxCami
Cityset by PSIONIC

UNAUTHORISED UPLOADS STRICTLY PROHIBITED, YOU WILL BE MET WITH A DMCA.


IF THE MOD OR SHIPSET DO NOT SHOW UP:
Check your error.log to make sure the mod files have been found. If it reads anything like "Could not find files for mod" then some numbers, that's the paradox launcher at work. According to the Paradoxplaza, the solution is deleting the mods_registry.json file and all the ugc numbered.mod files.


AS FOUND BY NIHIL!
[b] "I found you, you damnable saboteur!
launcher-v2.sqlite
This one singular piece of code is the only reason as to why this mod didn't want to work for me.
Removing it did the trick, the mod works perfectly once more.
If the mod shows up in the launcher, yet doesn't do so in the actual game, then look up that bit of code in your stellaris folder, and remove it." [/b]



Currently working on fixing things, I don't play stellaris any more (I dislike the direction 3.0+ took the game) but I'm workin on it :p

title: Amazing Space Battles
description:
[b][i]Compatible with Stellaris V4+ and V3.14
[/i][/b]
[img]https://imgur.com/z5QmOTt.gif[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/MTNW4je.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/SXV0IsV.gif[/img]

[b][h1]This Giant mod combines my previous graphical mods + far more, in order to completely improve the graphics of Stellaris space battles.[/h1][/b]
[b]It improves the graphics of almost EVERY weapon in the game- adding lots of new custom effects [i](while staying true to vannilla intentions)[/i], improved ship spacing and behavior in battles, adds new EPIC custom explosions, adds missing hit and muzzle effects paradox did not make, Creates custom effects for shield and hull hits + Space Battles are NOT over in seconds.

But above all, this mod makes space battles super fun to watch![/b]


[img]https://imgur.com/NH9XXA3.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/yy0wRF2.gif[/img]
[i]The new custom Titan explosion effect[/i]
[b][list]
    [*]New EPIC explosions for every ship type.
    [*]New Effects for all Lasers.
    [*]New Effects for all Kinetic Weapons.
    [*]New Effects for all Particle Launchers.
    [*]New Effects for all Missiles.
    [*]New Effects for all Disruptors.
    [*]New Effects for all autocannons.
    [*]New Effects for XL Weapons.
    [*]New Effects for Titan Weapon.
    [*]New Effects for anti-fighter - Flakk.
    [*]New Effects for all weapons when they hit shield or hull.
    [*]Effects get larger as gun size increases.
    [*]Improved Fighter behaviour and movement.
    [*]Slower ship movement during battles.
    [*]More intelligent ship spacing and behaviour during battles [i](no more face hugging fleets).[/i]
    [*]Better ship targeting i.e no more entire fleets targeting one ship at a time.
    [*]Graphical fixes for weapons without hit or muzzle effects.
    [*]Longer lasting battles
[/list][/b]

[b][i]Tip: Press Ctrl+F9 for a cinematic view.[/i][/b]

[b][i]The new weapon effects: [/i][/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/6KbfguU.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/7S66e5h.gif[/img]
[i]Gamma Laser Firing[/i]

[b] New and improved travel-laser effect, for better graphics but also making it easier to distinguish who is shooting who. Added new muzzle and hit effects.
[/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/DYQZJVp.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/u0POMKa.gif[/img]
[i]Missile Firing[/i]

[b] New missiles graphics with new smoke, exhaust and backblast effects. Added fire explosion and shards on impact.
[/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/E6UvsiO.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/iUNw9GA.gif[/img]
[i]Titan Laser Firing[/i]

[b] New effects for all XL weapons Including adaptive Lightning for arc emitters, Giga cannons Rail gun effect, Particle Lance beams and also this Epic Titan Perdition beam effect.
[/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/twB6hbi.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/LQdxLMO.gif[/img]
[i]Neutron Launcher Firing[/i]

[b] New and improved effects for particle launchers. Projectile improved to have a spinning-pulsating disk that is larger and far more visible. Added a new muzzle and hit effect to create a feeling of "Impact" and "power" for this high damage late-game weaponry.[/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/m4fIJDj.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/YWPl4t8.gif[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/gd2ok0c.gif[/img]
[i]Top: Two fleets engaging using kinetic weaponry[/i]   -    [i]Bottom: A Battleship firing autocannons[/i]

[b] Kinetic weapon graphics overhauled for more visibilty and color difference. Added different custom hit and muzzle effects for all varients of kinetic weapons. Also added new autocannon graphics for a more "Gatling Gun" look.[/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/xyEVc5t.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/KcAwIDX.gif[/img]
[i]Lvl 3 Disruptors Firing[/i]

[b] Disruptor graphics overhauled to better embody its description instead of a laser-like "blur". 

Vannilla description = [i]"Disruptors fire energy bolts that damage and destroy the molecular bonds holding the target's constituent atoms together. They completely ignore shields and armor and deal base damage directly to the hull." [/i]
[/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/UxHzZVG.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/V4PhiJY.gif[/img]
[i]A fleet defending itself using flak[/i]

[b] Added a new FLAK effect for all flak PD weapons (vannilla used the autocannon effect). [/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/SXuAHyc.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/mR548bh.gif[/img]
[i]Strike-Craft leaving ship carrier-hangars using the new animations[/i]

[b] More realistic Strike-craft animations and behaviour. Strike-craft dont perform pirouettes around ships anymore and have better spacing. Improved weapon graphics as well.[/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/zao8Yq9.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/Mt1KFmC.gif[/img]
[i]A battleship going down[/i]

[b] Overhauled improved explosion graphics for every ship type. More and custom pre-explosions before final explosion effect. Improved fire trails and a new lingering debree/sparks effect for the bigger ships.[/b]


[img]https://imgur.com/efLmCBK.png[/img]

[b]Please check-out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1524731904]Amazing Space Battles Collection[/url] for all of the Addon mods.[/b]

[b]For Medium to High-end PC's
I recommend: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1468105710]More Visible Particles[/url]

For Low to Medium-end PC's
I recommend: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1871684873]More Visible Particles (Lite)[/url][/b]


[img]https://imgur.com/5r1SSe6.png[/img]

[b]Steam Workshop link for the[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1880071041] Ironman Version [/url]
   [*][b]Achievement Compatible?: No. [i](A "trimmed-down" Ironman version is available)[/i][/b]
   [*]Savegame Compatible: Yes.

   [*]Compatible with mods adding custom ships.
   [*]Compatible with mods adding custom weapons and other items - altough they may need a patch for adding my gfx onto their weapons, otherwise their items use the vannilla effects.

   [*]Compatible with Real Space
   [*]NOT compatible with Real Space-ships-in-scaling (disable ships-in-scaling to use real space with ASB) 
   [*]Compatible with Downscaled ships
   [*]Compatible with NSC
[/b]
[b]You dont like the longer battles?
For these specific group of people I recommend:  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1881017456]ASB Addon: Shorter Battles [/url]

What you need to do if the mod descriptor file is missing or not automatically updating:

1. unsubscribe from mod
2. delete "mods_registry.json" -> User\Documents\Paradox Interactive\Stellaris
3. delete "ugc_1878473679.mod"-> User\Documents\Paradox Interactive\Stellaris\mod
4. subscribe to mod

This Giant mod combines my previous graphical mods + far more, in order to completely improve the graphics of Stellaris space battles.
It improves the graphics of almost EVERY weapon in the game- adding lots of new custom effects (while staying true to vannilla intentions), improved ship spacing and behavior in battles, adds new EPIC custom explosions, adds missing hit and muzzle effects paradox did not make, Creates custom effects for shield and hull hits + Space Battles are NOT over in seconds.

But above all, this mod makes space battles super fun to watch!


https://imgur.com/NH9XXA3.png
https://imgur.com/yy0wRF2.gif
The new custom Titan explosion effect

    [*]New EPIC explosions for every ship type.
    [*]New Effects for all Lasers.
    [*]New Effects for all Kinetic Weapons.
    [*]New Effects for all Particle Launchers.
    [*]New Effects for all Missiles.
    [*]New Effects for all Disruptors.
    [*]New Effects for all autocannons.
    [*]New Effects for XL Weapons.
    [*]New Effects for Titan Weapon.
    [*]New Effects for anti-fighter - Flakk.
    [*]New Effects for all weapons when they hit shield or hull.
    [*]Effects get larger as gun size increases.
    [*]Improved Fighter behaviour and movement.
    [*]Slower ship movement during battles.
    [*]More intelligent ship spacing and behaviour during battles (no more face hugging fleets).
    [*]Better ship targeting i.e no more entire fleets targeting one ship at a time.
    [*]Graphical fixes for weapons without hit or muzzle effects.
    [*]Longer lasting battles

The new weapon effects: 

https://imgur.com/6KbfguU.png
https://imgur.com/7S66e5h.gif
Gamma Laser Firing

 New and improved travel-laser effect, for better graphics but also making it easier to distinguish who is shooting who. Added new muzzle and hit effects.


https://imgur.com/DYQZJVp.png
https://imgur.com/u0POMKa.gif
Missile Firing

 New missiles graphics with new smoke, exhaust and backblast effects. Added fire explosion and shards on impact.


https://imgur.com/E6UvsiO.png
https://imgur.com/iUNw9GA.gif
Titan Laser Firing

 New effects for all XL weapons Including adaptive Lightning for arc emitters, Giga cannons Rail gun effect, Particle Lance beams and also this Epic Titan Perdition beam effect.

title: Ethics and Civics Classic (Primitive Nomad Update)
description:
[h1]Now Has Megacorp Civics + Early Space Age Origin! 
(If Linux User: Use Proton GE)[/h1]

*Niche bugs may exist, please report them on discord

Hello everyone!

Joakim is sadly retiring from the modding scene. I would like to thank him for maintaining/updating the mod ever since Petruxa left, he was carrying the torch for so long, and I am honored to be carrying it forward.

As custodian of the mod, I'll be keeping it up to date throughout patch releases. My first task was to optimize our code, as each update heavily broke it. I can now confidently say Ethics & Civics Classic is more compatible than ever. The mod has been cleared of any unnecessary vanilla code that caused conflicts/overrides. I've also commented the code to help identify any vanilla/modded changes for future Custodians. Lastly, I've updated the mod to have Megacorp Content! Megacorps can be Cooperative or Competitive Ethics.

I've also made the Stellaris mod "Distant Stars Overhaul & Playable Nanite Machines". If you enjoy, or would like to see distant stars expanded upon, check out DSO. It has built-in compatibility with E&C.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1971940221

- Coggernaut (Dated 6/8/2024)

****
MESSAGE FROM PETRUXA - THE ORIGINAL AUTHOR OF THIS MOD
At this point I don't have it in me to keep on maintaining this mod. In case anyone is interested, I'd be happy to make him a co-author, in order to continue running this page and update the mod himself. 

I leave everyone a right to take the mod as it is, and just make whatever he likes out of it. 

****
MESSAGE FROM Joakim.Westergaard - NEW CARETAKER OF THIS MOD
While I/We do try to keep this mod updated to a "working standard" since Petruxa left, I could certainly use help! This is especially concerning:
-Bug Fixing
-Updating when Stellaris updates (Major updates in particular it VERY time consuming)
-Translating the mod into other languages as I have neither the time or skills to update other the than English Localization.

********************************************************************************

IN CASE YOU DISCOVER A "BUG", YOU WISH TO REPORT, PLEASE, MAKE SURE THAT MY MOD IS SOURCE OF THAT BUG. IN ORDER TO DO IT, YOU HAVE TO DISABLE ALL OTHER MODS YOU USE, BESIDES MINE, AND CHECK IF THE BUG STILL OCCURS.  PRO TIP: Make a second playset in the laucher using only this mod - its quick and easy!

I am asking, because 99,9% of the reported "bugs" appear to be simple mods compatibility issues. Thanks for understanding.

*********************************************************************************

Click here to read [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1100284147/3114782965189865342/][h3]FULL INTRODUCTION[/h3][/url] (not updated since Petruxa did the mod but on the other hand not much has changed)
Brief introduction is available below.

We've also got a Discord Channel, this were bug reports should be made.
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/GpMvsTT][h3]DISORD[/h3][/url] channel.

*********************************************************************************

[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1100284147/3131667656045833024/]Click here to learn about existing COMPATIBILITY PATCHES[/url] [/b]

***************************************************************************

[b]BRIEF INTRODUCTION[/b]
**********************************

[b]- 2 new Ethical scales:[/b] 

[b]COOPERATIVE / COMPETITIVE[/b] - to reflect economic values of your society, reflecting the ownership of property and how wealth and means of production are distributed; 

[b]ECOCENTRIST / INDUSTRIALIST[/b] - to reflect Species relation towards their biosphere;

Basically, vanilla [b]Authoritarian - Egalitarian[/b] paradigm was transformed into 2 independent scales: [b]Authoritarian - Libertarian[/b] and [b]Competitive - Cooperative[/b], where [b]Authoritarian - Libertarian[/b] only reflects political values, and how political power is distributed between State and Citizens

[b]Number of available Ethic points was increased to 5[/b]

[b]around 50+ new Civics, along with some rebuild/modified vanilla Civics[/b]

New civics are of different types: [b]Green[/b] (regular) an [b]Yellow[/b] (so-called "themed governments"). Some of the vanilla Civics has been modified or disabled, in order to maintain the consistency of the Civics set as a whole.

[b]- a new Authority type:[/b] DIRECT DEMOCRACY

[b]- 30+ new Government forms[/b]

[b]- a range of new Policies: ECONOMIC STANCE, AUTHORITY STANCE, EDUCATION, HEALTHCARE, TRANSPORTATION, TELECOMMUNICATION, and a few new Trade policies[/b]

[b] - 20 new Jobs[/b]

[b] - Maximum Leader level has been increased to 20[/b]

[b]Localisations:[/b] English, and French are updated while other included languages are outdated! If someone want's to sign up and translate, Id be happy to include them.

Russian translation is found in this mod (Thanks to Fres): [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2991748106][/url]
*********************************************************************************
CONCERNING MISSING ETHICS IN UI. If you do not see all ethics in the game please confirm that you have no other mods touching the UI installed or that you have a compatibility path installed correctly (one is provided for UI Overhaul).

ALSO: The images shown in the mod description are outdated (alas, cannot update these). The number of Ethics are fewer than shown, e.g. Pluralist has been removed. The mod windows work if you see an ethic line called cooperative/competitive.

[h1]Built-in Mod Compatibility[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2806903835&searchtext=government+variety+pack]Government Variety Pack[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2807759164&tscn=1724528116]! The Merger of Rules 3.12[/url]

[h1]Integrated Mods[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2631525996&tscn=1725488560]Criminal Heritage Expanded - Inclusion consented by author: N0bbody[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=915966120&tscn=1728954118]Primitive Players - Inclusion consented by author: Pode[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2531304441]Pirate Ship Set (standalone) - Inclusion consented by author: Pilgrim[/url]


[b]Modder Note:[/b]
I will strive to make E&C as compatible with other mods as possible. Please reach out on [url=https://discord.gg/GpMvsTT]Discord[/url] to collaborate on building built-in compatibility :)

An on-start global flag has been set:
has_global_flag = ethic_civic_classic_active
has_global_flag = cultural_overhaul_active

[b]Art Contributors:[/b]
This list is not comprehensive of all artists due to many contributors names being unknown. Here are the names of those that I do know: ormr1776, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/KorolSynthStudios]Levorue
[/url], and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198850434756/myworkshopfiles/]Alan Kraskow[/url].

[b]Code Contributors:[/b]
This list is not comprehensive of all coders due to many contributors names being unknown. Here are the names of those that I do know: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198133146441/]Emperor (Szatan2000
)[/url], Dracony, Sage Wilde, SteamPnk42, Enriadhodor, Gregor Samsa, Aztexa, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198858429698/]FirePrince[/url].

[b]Localization Contributors:[/b]
This list is not comprehensive of all coders due to many contributors names being unknown. Here are the names of those that I do know: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198050228481/]Emmanuel DH (French Loc)[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Miracle_Kagari/]Miracle_Kagari (Chinese Loc)[/url].

title: Planetary Diversity - Unique Worlds
description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]
[h1]Stellaris: 4.4.*[/h1]
[h1]Not Achievement Friendly[/h1]
[h1][url=https://discord.gg/qHuWBhaZpg]PD Discord Server[/url][/h1]

[h1]Unique Worlds[/h1]
This mod is standalone and does not require Planetary Diversity to function. It adds additional planets, scaling based on the size of your galaxy. In a huge galaxy, you will encounter all of them. Each planet will spawn only once, and only if no empire has claimed the corresponding origin. If an empire uses the origin, the planet will not spawn elsewhere in your game. Two empires can select the origin simultaneously. 

Please review the images above for specific details and costs.

[h2]Floating World[/h2]
[h3]Continental Planet Class[/h3]
The Floating World is where vast islands drift among the clouds. Eludium, a rare and powerful resource, causes this phenomenon, unlocking unique technologies and exclusive edicts. Claim the secrets of Eludium before your rivals do!
[h3]Origin: Islands in the Sky.[/h3] Your people evolved on the drifting islands themselves, and Eludium is simply the ground beneath their feet. You start with the only supply in the galaxy.

[h2]Crystal World[/h2]
[h3]Tropical Planet Class[/h3]
The Crystal World is covered in towering pillars of pure Acean Crystal, which will unlock unique technologies and exclusive edicts. Uncover the planet's secrets and the fate of those who once tried to call it home.
[h3]Origin: Crystalborn.[/h3] Your people rose in the shadow of the Acean pillars, and the crystal has shaped their bodies and their growth ever since. What it can be made to do is yours alone to learn.

[h2]Biosynthetic World[/h2]
[h3]Alpine Planet Class[/h3]
A strange world covered in artificial canals and biosynthetic creatures unlocks unique technologies, planetary decisions, and special Living Metal Edicts. Will you uncover the mystery of who built this world? And when you do, will their creations join your empire, or will you seal their fate?
[h3]Origin: Children of Unit 04.[/h3] You are the creations. Grown from Living Metal by a Warform that turned from destroying worlds to making life, your people are assembled rather than born, and your leaders never age. Unit 04 holds the seat of government until you can make your own kind without it. Requires The Machine Age.

[h3]More Unique worlds are on their way![/h3]

[h1]Click this link for the [url=https://discord.gg/qHuWBhaZpg]PD Discord Server[/url]. Please go there for FAQs, questions, comments, or bug reports.[/h1]
[h3] I'm no longer allowing comments on this workshop item due to the numerous rude messages and people not reading the mod description. Sorry to anyone who doesn't have access to Discord.[/h3]

[h2]What is this Mod? (in English)[/h2]

This mod adds a new ship set to the game, with 4 skin variants. The set also includes models for Starbases, Defence Platforms, Habitats and Hyper Relays (among others). Furthermore, the mod also adds 3 new cityscape sets to the game for your use. 

All models/skins are tested and up to date for Stellaris 4.3+. Simply download, activate and enjoy!

[h3]Compatibility[/h3]

The United Fleet shipset is wholly compatible with most mods, including NSC, Real Space, Gigastructural Engineering etc.

However, downloading compatibility patches is recommended for several mods, notably NSC and Downscaled Ships. You can access those here:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3202136738] NSC/United Fleet Patch [/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2252191029] Downscaled Ships/United Fleet Patch [/url] 

[h3]Troubleshooting/Main Issues[/h3]

Q. My frigate turrets are floating!
A. This is due to a compatibility error with NSC. Simply download the NSC/United Fleet Patch (noted above) and load it after both NSC and the main United Fleet mod.

Q. This crashes my game!
A. It shouldn't. Disable your other mods to make sure there are no conflicts.

As always, if you experience problems with the mod then run it alone and see if your problem persists. Any other questions, please do not hesitate to ask!

description:
[img=https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/18372888851566406473/E765B22404B58839F2AF2D34F0CB94089095CF36/]
[h1][b]Current version [ver260818] for [Stellaris 4.4]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2660560781]Legacy version of Kasako's mods[/url]
Up to 75% increase in game fluency in later game
New pop growth control method (disabled by default)
Automatic demotion function
Express manual pop migration method
Reduce the number of ships
Prohibit species hybridization
Stop AI from modifying species
Prohibit or restrict AI habitat and ringworld construction
Prohibit AI gateway construction
Sumpreme species integration function[/b][/h1]

-Can reduce number of ships: small ships are merged into large ships, which is only effective for ordinary empires and fallen empires, and may affect AI behavior mode. Use it with caution
-Species integration mode: Combine similar species into one species according to the species category (organic/stone/mechanical) and the integration of civil rights (random selection of templates)
-Targeted integration template: use a species as an integration template by adding features or make it ignore integration

[h3][b]User tips: [/b][/h3]
-If it is unnecessary, don't change any of the default settings, unless you know what you are doing.
-Any contents marked "experimental function" are not recommanded.
-The pop limit function is for old users. If you don't know ihow it works, please do not turn on.
-Trade optimization will shut down vanilla trade route, but trade income will be given by a new method.

[h3][b]Compatibility and sorting: [/b][/h3]
-Theoretically, it is not compatible with any mod that modified  "00_on_actions.txt". If you must use them together, place this MOD at the BOTTOM of your playback.
