title: Dynamic Political Events
description:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1227620643/1620599015888726457/]Описание мода на русском языке (Russian Description)[/url] 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1227620643/1692659769945543549/]Descrição do Mod em Português (Portuguese Description)[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2131014154]Chinese Version[/url] 

Stellaris empires lack life. It often does not feel like one is leading a stellar empire with real citizens whose opinions matter. Imagine if we (us Humans) suddenly weren’t the only species on our planet – how we get on with the others would soon be one of [b]the[/b] big topics. Or if machines produced half our output suddenly, one could imagine it might be difficult to adjust. These societal factors are currently not represented well in Stellaris - there are the factions, but they don't have events surrounding them. This mod seeks to change this by adding a large and growing number of event chains that will bring the politics of your empire to life. Some are positive, many are negative, others are more ambiguous. They will make you make decisions, not all of which will be obvious

 Storylines include:
 • Various events to do with integrating alien species, including tensions between species and your attitude towards interspecies marriages.
 • Events focusing on pops’ and factions’ specific demands (e.g. emancipation movements).
 • Colonisation Stories – your new colonists on a planet might choose their own leader or how they wish to organise themselves.
 • Establish a ruler cult to your emperor.
 • Various scandals and Conspiracies.
 • Events affecting interstate relations.
 • And more (more than 55,000 words of text in total). See the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1227620643/1697168437861698866/]full list of events[/url] (spoilers alert) for details.

An aim of this mod is to make your empire’s ethics more important to the game. So, naturally, some events are more likely to happen if you have a certain ethic (or can only come then). Your choices are also determined by them – for instance, many events have a “Kill. Them. All.” option that is only available to certain empires like fanatic purifiers and fanatic authoritarians. I didn’t want to be too restrictive, though – most of the time, any ethic but egalitarian can choose to oppress pops that protest about stuff. As part of the mod, ethic pulls have been rebalanced a bit. The gist is that now if your empire does well, it is better at keeping control of ethics, but if it doesn’t or its pops are displeased, it does worse (more so than in Vanilla). Also, if groups of pops of the same ethic are present on a planet, it will be harder to get rid of them, so opposition will clump – something which is important for factional revolts (and realistic).

[b]Bugs[/b]: Please report anything that seems weird or is a bug.

[b]Compatibility[/b]:
 -This mod will not conflict or even overlap with any of the other event mods that we know of, including the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=727000451]More Events Mod[/url] 
 -Many of our events elicit reactions from factions. Obviously, this won’t happen for non-Vanilla factions.
 -We have no idea what will happen if you run this with STNH.

[b]Languages[/b]:
 - English
 - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/mikadukibomber]Russian[/url] - knon_20, CBeTou, Dalarin
 - Portuguese (95%) - Berenoi
 - French (40%) - Aven, Mikado
 - German (25%) - Caligula Caesar, Morindil, SpaceDundee, Ryan/Cooper
 - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1339306759]Chinese[/url] - shishic
 - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/mikadukibomber]Japanese[/url] (95%) - Mikaduki

All not-yet translated stuff will display in English so as not to break localisations. If anyone wants to help with translations, let us know!

[b]FAQ[/b]:
 -I have had no events yet. Assuming you are not playing as a gestalt, bear in mind that the events in this mod are randomly triggered depending on various conditions. It is possible to have many occur or none.
 -Savegame compatibility? Yes, so far as we know.
 -Are there events for Gestalt Consciousnesses in this mod? Almost none, they simply have no politics.
 -Achievement Compatibility? No (few mods are).
 -Does this AI get these events? Yes.

[b]The Future[/b]: We consider this mod to be complete as it is. Current commitments mean that we are unlikely to add to it, but I will continue to fix bugs as they arise and maintain compatibility with Vanilla updates when needed. If you have a question, the sure-fire way is to ping MrFunEGUY or I somewhere on the Stellaris Modding Den:
[url=https://discord.gg/CMjnnET][img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/414864703714623488/464115780532043797/logo_beveled_Caligula.png[/img][/url]

title: !!Universal Modifier Patch (4.4.*)
description:
Fix the modifier issue after the 2.2.6 update.

With the release of 2.2.6, once again, Paradox fools buried countless of mods and modders into the abyss.
This fix mod brings the missing modifiers that existed in 2.2.0 to 2.2.5 back to life. (via overweight 00_common_categories.txt load order to make them generate again)
Such as pop jobs related modifiers, megastructure cost, planetary decision cost, specific leader cost & upkeep… etc.

You only need to subscribe this "fix" mod, if one of your subscribed mods or more edited vanilla file "00_common_categories.txt", which will conflict each other when loading the game.
Let me know if I forget to add certain modifiers into it.

[h1][b]Keep in mind that the mod does NOT affect any existing in-game bugs besides economy modifiers bonus, please reproduce the bug in vanilla and report to Paradox.[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Compatility[/b][/h1]
No vanilla file overwritten.
Not Achievement compatible.

Has built-in support with the following mods, note that these are the example that they had modified and done workaround for vanilla economy category.
As long as your subscribed mod doesn’t edit economy category, they are compatible with this patch.
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1885775216]Extra Ship Components[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=683230077](NSC2)[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2027087815]Realistic Ships[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=865040033]Guilli's Planet Modifiers and Features[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2441507863]Machine & Robot Expansion[/url]
[/list]

title: 鸽组汉化
description:
[h1]巨构工程学 Gigastructural Engineering & More 已发布独立汉化模组，包含[b]配置菜单[/b]。点击图片前往订阅：[/h1]
原“更多巨构”
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3772088387][img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/11320980944832993667/0679450BCA6336F4FFAA721C715F0269A7AED765/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img][/url]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/13374017202690092676/27E01D9608DEB46116CA84C8862867C0C0B2EB9C/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10687749988958607768/500E5FD0DE74E9E89C78E54DF19B0AF0B057F853/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]



[h1]简介[/h1][hr][/hr]
翻译群星创意工坊的英文模组。仅含汉化文本，不会实质性修改游戏内容。
不包含替换了原版文本的模组，因为会导致文本互相冲突、覆盖。此类模组会内置汉化，或上传独立汉化补丁。
由于近来P社官中问题较多，原则上以本组制作的[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2812860898]官中修正[/url]作为翻译基准。非模组玩家也可以单独订阅使用。
本模组没有的，可以看看创意工坊有没有其他朋友做的汉化
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1324813584]旧版鸽组汉化[/url]将不再更新，仅供旧版本玩家订阅。



[h1]汉化列表[/h1][hr][/hr]
列表有粗略分类与译名参考；合集订阅方便。两者可能更新不同步存在差别。

列表存在过时情况，修缮工作在做了

[h1][b]集中汉化：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2131014154/2523653167119488924]列表[/url] / [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2459626292]合集[/url][/b][/h1]
[h1][b]内置汉化：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2131014154/2574320091917088731]列表[/url] / [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2459677392]合集[/url][/b][/h1]
[h1][b]独立汉化：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2131014154/5624408883140165181]列表[/url] / [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2459685305]合集[/url][/b][/h1]

[h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2829207309]其他汉化者作品合集[/url][/h1]



[h1]常见问题[/h1][hr][/hr]
[olist]
[*][b]汉化不生效？[/b]首先请确认你的启动器与游戏本体语言设置为中文，否则模组不会生效。

    [*][b]文本缺失？[/b]请先尝试自行或使用下方工具删除原模组内置的假中文。如果仍然失效，请尝试将汉化覆盖入原模组语言文件夹。
    
    [*][b]排序？[/b]置于需要汉化的模组下方即可。
[/olist]

模组过多容易互相冲突，报错崩溃、文本异常是正常情况，请适量使用。



[h1]推荐工具[/h1][hr][/hr]
[quote=MSTnoin]
[h1]GZ SWEEPER 假中文删除工具[/h1] 汉化不全救星！假中文屠宰者3000！
使用 MSTnoin 为您带来的全新体验，一键删除所有假中文，不再有中英随机混杂的烦恼！
[b][url=https://github.com/MSTnoin/gz_sweeper/releases/tag/main_pub]GitHub[/url]
工坊不让我放度盘，留个尾巴：s/1RVSY6pG0tYsGFPO5VKfTlA  0721[/b]

使用步骤
1. 下载 exe 文件；
2. 放入群星工坊文件夹，默认为 ...\steamapps\workshop\content\281990
3. 运行并按提示操作
[/quote]

title: Expanded Stellaris Traditions
description:
[h1][b]Stellaris 4.4.*[/b] /// [/h1]
[h1]Intro>[/h1]
This mod adds 44 new Tradition Trees to the game with an extensive use of tradition swapping, which depends on what you or the AI plays.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Playing a hive-mind, or an authoritarian dictatorship? In that case, liberal democracy style traditions will be swapped out for more fitting stuff.
[*] Not using Robots? Traditions giving bonuses to robots will give different bonuses. Same things for slavery, megastructures etc.
[*] Theme changing with your empire. The Order tree will be very different for a Slaving Autocracy and an Egalitan empire.[/list]
[*] Built-in AI support. Either the AI is able to use a tradition properly, or they will have an easier-to-use swap giving a corresponding bonus.
[*] Traditions do not only contains passive bonuses, more interesting effects, such as:
[list]
[*] Bonuses depending on your playstyle, conditioned on fulfilling special conditions. 
[*] Adding new buildings, edicts, jobs, policies, technologies, traits, etc.
[*] Gain resources for destroying enemy ships, raid neighbouring empires, pick virtues for your leaders, and much more interesting stuff.[/list]
[*] Unique icons, tree layouts, and well-written flavour texts for all traditions.
[*] Full compatibility with other mods.[/list]

[h1]Important Information - Please Read[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]There is a Delta Dev branch version of this mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3181487775]found here[/url]. 
[*] The full list of traditions and their effect can be found on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/946222466/1368380298845330220/]this description page[/url]. This includes swaps and information which might not be revealed from just looking at the description. If you want to min-max, read this. Probably read it either way.
[*] Please read the "Providing Bug Reports" section before providing a bug report.
[*] Certain traditions have passive negative effects on other empires (like penalties to rivals). The AI does not use them, but you can make it use them using an option in the "common/scrippted_triggers/est_options.txt" file.
[*] Please provide feedback and bug reports for my ascension perk mod at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1067631798]that mod's page[/url].
[*]For non-English languages, localisation is provided in English only (translation mods are encouraged).
[*]Anyone is free to make and maintain alternative versions of this mod, however, please inform me if you do so.[/list]

[h1]Providing Bug Reports[/h1]
Please report all bugs that you find. However, it would be very helpful if you could follow these steps to make it easier for me to fix the bug:
[list]
[*]Please report your bugs [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/946222466/1368380934255352546/]at this discussion page[/url]. I can't always fix bugs as they are reported, and if you only report them in the main discussion they very easily get swamped by other comments by the time I can look at them.
[*] Please describe what is the problem. "X doesn't work" is not very helpful.
[*] Please provide a screenshot, it is very helpful.
[*] Please try and confirm whenever the bug persists with only this mod present.[/list]

[h1]Expanded Stellaris Ascension Perks[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1067631798]My other mod which adds 45 new Ascension Perks to the game[/url]. Lots of interesting perks included (rather than flat bonus modifiers). Alternatively, for those that want the latest (sometimes experimental) features faster, please check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2976573664]Expanded Stellaris Ascension Perks (Delta)[/url] instead.

[h1]Giving Input[/h1]
The vast majority of all playthroughs with this mod are not done by me, to make it as good as possible I need all the input I can get. Please come with any input that you have, a large amount of the input I receive actually have real input on this mod. Please note that there are appropriate pages at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/discussions/946222466]the discussions tab of this mod[/url] for each type of input.
[list]
[*] [b]Balance:[/b] While top priority has been to come up with interesting themes and traditions for all trees I do believe this is not incompatible with having a balanced mod. All input on which trees/traditions you find too strong to weak is appreciated (some traditions might be left weaker to offset stronger traditions in the same tree, but all trees should be roughly balanced.
[*] [b]Bugs:[/b] I test everything that I upload. However, this mod gets quite complex and in certain cases, there might be a bug. There is also a lot of stuff in it so I've probably missed a few things as well. Right now it should be quite solid, with the next update there might be a few new ones though. Please report!
[*] [b]Spelling:[/b] English is not my first language (however I try to check everything with a spell checker). If you find some error, tell me and I will fix it.
[*] [b]Suggestions:[/b] Have any cool ideas for new traditions? Have any ideas for new trees. I am open to suggestions. No promises but if you have something I will think about it at least.
[*] [b]Icons:[/b] Since patch 3.1 each tradition tree is associated with an icon (in the top left corner). I currently have copied from the vanilla tradition, but if anyone could provide some custom made ones for the mod I would be very grateful. 
[/list]

[h1]Translations[/h1]
EST has English native support and has localization set in place for translators, translations are handled in separate mods that have to go below EST in the mod load order, here is a list of translations so far:
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177]French[/url] (Thank you Stern)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3546900233]Chinese 1[/url] (Thank you 恐粉症(狐狼徒弟))
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2131014154]Chinese 2[/url] (Thank you Doves)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2617298932]Russian[/url] (Thank you knon_20)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3537531879]Spanish[/url] (Thank you fedekk2014)
[/list]

[h1]Credits[/h1]
[b]Birdy[/b] (Maker of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=903007094]Plentiful Traditions Mod[/url])
Quite a few things in this mod is inspired by their work.
[list]
[*] The theme of the Malice tree is their idea (but the content my own).
[*] I renamed my biogenesis and faith trees to use Birdy's, better, names.
[*] They came up with the idea to "collapse" the discovery tree to gain space.
[*] They figured out how to make the scrollbar so you could fit more traditions in, I used that idea as well.[/list]
(There are a few more cases where we have traditions with the same name, these are coincidence)
[b]Maethydd[/b]
The tradition version of the old ethics Individualism/Collectivism traditions was first introduced in their tradition mod.
[b]Rokhmal[/b]
Have written a lot of very nice traditions descriptions for the mod.

[h1]Thanks[/h1]
[b]Birdy[/b]
For being cool with me using some of their ideas.
[b]The guys in the Stellaris Mod Discord Channel[/b]
Got lots of help here.
[b]MightNight[/b]
Miscellaneous support and suggestion.
[b]Mayonnaiz[/b]
Miscellaneous suggestion.
[b]The guys in the Stellaris Mod Forum[/b]
Also gave a few tips.
[b]The creators of CWTools for Paradox Modding[/b]
This seriously makes the modding process three times easier.
[b]Expanded Stellaris 3 Dev team[/b]
Ben_D, Kroun, Furrnomenon and A-Sartek which collaborated to keep this mod alive.

title: Planetary Diversity - Exotic Worlds
description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]
[h1]Stellaris: 4.4.*[/h1]
[h1]Not Achievement Friendly[/h1]
[h1][url=https://discord.gg/qHuWBhaZpg]PD Discord Server[/url][/h1]
[h1]Requires: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=819148835]Planetary Diversity[/url][/h1]

This mod is an addition to Planetary Diversity. It will not work without the main PD mod active.

This mod adds exotic species archetypes and the world classes they call home. Each archetype comes with a dedicated species class, climate-specific world types, and a full suite of matching districts, jobs, buildings, deposits, and terraforming paths. Cryophile habitats are pressurized to match their atmosphere, and exotic worlds can become arcologies with the More Arcologies submod.

[h1]Cryophiles[/h1]
[h3]Cryogenic World Classes: Ammonia, Methane, Nitrogen[/h3]
Cold-loving extremophile species that thrive on cryogenic worlds and can survive on cold ones, but are unwelcome on temperate ones. As a species adapted to frozen atmospheres, Cryophiles metabolize exotic gases to live, making the resource part of their daily upkeep rather than just an industrial good. Each planet-class has its own economic identity and native districts, including a unique gas-extraction job that turns the frozen environment into a working economy. The Cryothermal Engineering ascension perk rounds out the late game.

[h1]Acidophiles[/h1]
[h3]Planned[/h3]
An acid- and sulfur-loving class of species built around hot, chemically corrosive worlds. 

[h1]Umbraphiles[/h1]
[h3]Planned[/h3]
A shadow-dwelling species class adapted to worlds locked in perpetual darkness. The low-light economy opens up playstyles unavailable on sunlit worlds.

title: Planetary Diversity - More Arcologies
description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]
[h1]Stellaris: 4.4.*[/h1]
[h1]Not Achievement Friendly[/h1]
[h1][url=https://discord.gg/qHuWBhaZpg]PD Discord Server[/url][/h1]

This mod is 100% stand-alone and will work without [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=819148835]Planetary Diversity[/url].

[h1]This mod adds five new Arcologies to the game. All features of this mod are created using planetary decisions.[/h1]

[h1]Capital Arcs/Deposits[/h1]
The choice is dependent on your Authority.
The Senate Dome is for Democratic and Oligarchic.
The Palace is for Dictatorial and Imperial.
Hives and Machines have their own.
Capital arcs have been replaced with a decision that can be made on any Arcology, Hive, or Machine World you control. This will change the planet portrait and the planet model for the Vanilla City World. They all take up three districts but give you 18 jobs and local and empire-wide bonuses based on your authority. Once you have unlocked the anti-gravity building tech, there is a Ringworld (full Ringworlds only) and Habitat version.


[h1]Arcologies - Regular & Rogue Servitors[/h1]
Arcologies are created via decisions. Once a planet meets the requirements, you may select its corresponding decision, as with regular arcologies. Each arc has a special housing district and one special district that matches its theme.
[h2]Garden Arcology[/h2]
[h3]Adaptability or Discovery Tradition[/h3]
This utopian ecumenopolis features large, country-sized nature parks and a specialized Nature Preserve district.
[h2]Commercial Arcology[/h2]
[h3]Prosperity or Mercantile Tradition[/h3]
This utopian ecumenopolis features large, country-sized trade plazas and a specialized Resort district.
[h2]Fortress Arcology[/h2]
[h3]Supremacy or Unyielding Tradition[/h3]
This Military Powerhouse focuses on military administration, defense, and a specialized Military Admin district.

[h1]New Buildings[/h1]
[h3]Naval Office[/h3] (requires Planetary Defenses)
Serves as a support hub for your fleets, adding Logistics Specialist or Logistics Drone jobs, providing Naval Capacity and Society Research. Upgrades to the [b]Naval Command Center[/b] (requires Global Defense Grid), which doubles job output and acts as a Planetary FTL Inhibitor.
[h3]Bio-Trophy Council[/h3] (Rogue Servitor)
Places Bio-Trophies in leadership roles to produce Unity, boost planet-wide drone job output, and provide additional housing.

[h1]IMPORTANT NOTES[/h1]
Rogue Servitors use normal Arcologies, not Machine ones.
There is no support for non-vanilla-modded authorities. They will need a patch to work with any government mods you use.

[h1]Click this link for the [url=https://discord.gg/qHuWBhaZpg]PD Discord Server[/url]. Please go there for FAQs, questions, comments, or bug reports.[/h1]
[h3] I'm no longer allowing comments on this workshop item due to the numerous rude messages and people not reading the mod description. Sorry to anyone who doesn't have access to Discord.[/h3]

title: Ancient Cache of Technologies
description:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]

[url=https://stellarisacot.wiki.gg/] ACOT now has a wiki!.[/url]

Ancient Cache of Technology explores the stories of the ancient enigmatic precursors, including the Curators, the Fallen Empires and those that came before them. Behind their history lies great many secrets yet to be rediscovered.

The Fallen Empires thought they mastered the Enigmatic Power, their dark matter and energy weapons supreme. But for how long? What if an empire manages to rise and learn their secrets, what if they surpass the known knowledge of the past, and forge a new future thought impossible?

This mod introduces a large varieties of new technologies based on the enigmatic powers. From ship weapons, to buildings, to armies or planetary decisions. Technologies are categorized into tiers, and there are event chains that each empire has to go through to acquire them...or steal them from the others.

Due to vanilla's lacking army contents, this mod also expands upon armies as well. Most importantly, the Hive Mind gets to have their own armies now (No more zerglings running home due to low morale)

Furthermore, the mod buffs the existing Fallen Empire worlds to be much harder to invade, with their home citadels now fully protected, their outlying planets now have proper FE-tier buildings and their armies now much harder to beat.

It also buffs and expands upon the Curator Order a lot, as well as adding an entirely new neutral leviathan-like faction who holds a massive starbase, waiting for someone to challenge them.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1504307690] ACOT Override Function - Get this if you want Leviathan/Crisises to also be buffed.[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1481972266&tscn=1718224164] ACOT Secrets Beyond the Gate - For another End Game Crisis with ACOT lore.[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2288335512&tscn=1718693890] ACOT Extra Defines - For supplementary changes to make ACOT experiences better.[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3033118635] Optional Russian Localization.[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177] Optional French Localization.[/url]

[h1]Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] Six new tiers of technology. One begins right at where the final vanilla tier ends. Two can be obtained as you progress further into utilizing Dark Matter and Dark Energy, another is a rare technology only a few can possess. One can be unlocked through hard exploring and efforts, and two can be unlocked by defeating a certain faction and figures out its puzzle.

[*] Expanded ship sections and new stages of bio-ships that bring them up to the level as the Fallen Hive Empires.

[*] Dark Energy and Stellarite as new strategic resources. Dark Matter also becomes much more important, as various components now require both to build.

[*] Over 699 new technologies, many of which require special conditions to be met.

[*] Armies Expansion. Normal, Hive, and Machine now have a selection of armies they can create to conquer their enemies.

[*] New Building technologies based on enigmatic powers. Some of which offers unique planetary decisions.

[*] New types of Planetary Bombardment Stances such as Punishment, Exterminatus and Annihilatus! Each with increasing degree of destruction. But planets can also retaliate against them with planet-size orbital defense cannons.

[*] Battle against the massively enhanced fallen empires to claim their ancient technologies as your own in War in Hell.

[*] Discover long lost and forgotten technologies, including the ability to create new celestial bodies, eradicate systems, or making self-assembling megastructure.

[*] Interact with the Curators to discover various histories and secrets. Or just rob them (Destroying their stations will now give you enigmatic tech)

[*] Meets the Phanon Corps, an illusive third-party paramilitary faction whose motives are unknown.

[*] New origins including those that  allows an empire to start at higher tech tiers.

[*] Some updated vanilla assets.

[/list]    

[h1]Known Issues and Limitations[/h1]

[list]

[*] This mod expects you to read some of the events, and apply some basic logic and thinking based on clues and how the events are written or represented. Trial and Errors are expected. Avoid doing Ironman run unless you know what you're doing.

[*] This mod made use of some AI-generated images. If you don't like that, you should avoid this mod! 
or grab this submod.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=3662942555 
For more details, refer to https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1419304439/761806632715998369/

[*]  Using this mod alongside mods that already buffs FEs may hilariously turn their power to over 9000. So be warned.

[*] Some bugs may happen. Please report them, preferbly on Discord.
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]

[list]
[*] You were expecting to see balance in this mod? This is not an E-Sports game.

[*] On a more serious note, components at Delta and Alpha follows vanilla 1.3x formula, later tiers have increased multiplier.

[*] Economy is still being ironed out at the moment. Everything's likely going to be overpowered with the changes to how 4.0 economy works.

[*] This is mostly an end-game mod, so AIs that fall behind in technologies tend to get memed a lot. But that's why the FEs and the Corps are for.
[/list]

[h1]Save and Mod Compatibility[/h1]

[list]
[*] Hopefully will works on existing saves, but some stuffs may not work.

[*] Overwrites most vanilla assault and defense armies.

[*] Overwrites has_upgraded_capital_building and all of its upgraded variation to accept the new capital tier.

[*] Overwrites some Curator Events (Specifically their introduction and hiring scientists)

[*] Overwrites resource_table in the interface, but this mod's override function has accounted for
1. Gigastructure's
2. ESC
3. Guille's
4. Arcane Heritage
5. Unknown's Component.
6. Twink's Playable Fallen Empire.

It's been a while since I update that list though, better to just grab a universal SR Patch
If your mod has unique SRs and wish to add them, feel free to poke me.

[*]  Overwrites fallen_empire_initializers and many of it's associated scripts so that FE will spawn with new FE buildings.

[*]  Overwrites fallen empire designs.

[*]  Overwrites NArmy Defines.

[*]  Overwrites certain elements of Cosmogenesis and The Synth Queen Crisis.

[/list]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]

Q: I cannot upgrade my capital!
A: You have to do it via planetary decision. This is also explained in the tech description.

[h1]Credits and Special Thanks to[/h1]

- Many of the artwork icons are from the following games, I do not claim ownerships of those arts. I will take them down if the companies have issues with them.
[list]
[*] Command & Conquer 3 and Tiberium Alliance - EA Games
[*] Starcraft 2 and Heroes of the Storm - Blizzard
[*] Dawn of War 2 - Relic/Games Workshop
[*] Heroes of Might and Magic: V - Ubisoft
[/list]


- Wymorlon, SOPHIA, Velaroz, H11DN-D4NG3R, Raine for Discord Server Moderation.

- Garyx, Fragjacker for helping with some art assets.

- Other Panda for some code optimizations (Even if he does makes me explode a few times.)

- NHunter, I studied the codes for mod menu and certain components from his mod.

- Stellaris Modding Den Community, learned many useful stuffs there.

- All supporters. Your sacrifice against the FE will be honored in the New Empire.

I have a section on Discord for my mods here
[url=https://discord.gg/XvJANRdq57]ACOT Main Discord Server[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/CMjnnET][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Und3QN.png[/img][/url]

You can also support me on Patreon  [url=https://www.patreon.com/user?u=10674702]here [/url].

title: Diverse Rooms
description:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/V3Z5O15.png[/img]

[URL=https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/request-a-room-button-see-post-for-mockup-images.1498973/][B]PLEASE SIGN THE PETITION FOR A SCROLLABLE ROOM LIST![/B][/URL]

Stellaris' basic rooms are just that: 'basic'. I've always found them a little uninspiring and bland. Every single empire you encounter talks to you from a similar rectangular room, with a slightly different window, looking out onto a slightly different planetary surface with some slightly different form of city on it. I get it, it's functional and efficiently conveys the information you want it to convey to the player..

However, I feel those rooms do not do justice to the wonderful stories Stellaris sometimes creates, the sense of awe you should feel when you encounter a Fallen Empire, the shock at stepping onto an Artist Enclave and seeing a multitude of alien races, and so on..

[b]What does this mod do exactly?[/b]
[list][*]Adds close to 300 more rooms
[*]Makes available to the player some of the 'hidden' Paradox rooms[/list]

If you're using Diverse Rooms and are contacted by one of your own custom-made races (with a room from this mod), it's highly likely you'll encounter a bug that we haven't been able to squash yet: first you'll see the 'basic' room for the race's government type and, when you contact them again, you'll see the room you assigned them from Diverse Rooms. 

If this bothers you immensely, I highly recommend using the companion mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1399069277]Diverse Basics[/url] to mitigate the effects.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/kmsMpJE.png[/img]
[list][*]Potentially more Rooms...
[*]Companion mods that are split by biome or theme, limited 'bloat' in Diverse Rooms
[*]Continued updates as Stellaris is updated
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/902204956/133261907139243840/]Post links or suggest what kind of room you'd like to see here..[/url][/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DlOTDMv.png[/img]
Ironman compatible! (Unless the ironman mode is lying to me). Should have no other mod compatibility issues, unless that mod somehow extensively reworks how Stellaris uses the room backgrounds.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qUlyQsE.png[/img]

[URL=https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/request-a-room-button-see-post-for-mockup-images.1498973/]PLEASE SIGN THE PETITION FOR A SCROLLABLE ROOM LIST!

Stellaris' basic rooms are just that: 'basic'. I've always found them a little uninspiring and bland. Every single empire you encounter talks to you from a similar rectangular room, with a slightly different window, looking out onto a slightly different planetary surface with some slightly different form of city on it. I get it, it's functional and efficiently conveys the information you want it to convey to the player..

However, I feel those rooms do not do justice to the wonderful stories Stellaris sometimes creates, the sense of awe you should feel when you encounter a Fallen Empire, the shock at stepping onto an Artist Enclave and seeing a multitude of alien races, and so on..

What does this mod do exactly?
[*]Adds close to 300 more rooms
[*]Makes available to the player some of the 'hidden' Paradox rooms

If you're using Diverse Rooms and are contacted by one of your own custom-made races (with a room from this mod), it's highly likely you'll encounter a bug that we haven't been able to squash yet: first you'll see the 'basic' room for the race's government type and, when you contact them again, you'll see the room you assigned them from Diverse Rooms. 

If this bothers you immensely, I highly recommend using the companion mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1399069277]Diverse Basics to mitigate the effects.

https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif

http://i.imgur.com/kmsMpJE.png
[*]Potentially more Rooms...
[*]Companion mods that are split by biome or theme, limited 'bloat' in Diverse Rooms
[*]Continued updates as Stellaris is updated
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/902204956/133261907139243840/]Post links or suggest what kind of room you'd like to see here..

https://i.imgur.com/DlOTDMv.png
Ironman compatible! (Unless the ironman mode is lying to me). Should have no other mod compatibility issues, unless that mod somehow extensively reworks how Stellaris uses the room backgrounds.

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1845920402463047022/704A6544BA51270CE7DB5161E401AF88E54A2EF4/[/img]
 [b]战舰少女是本MOD中三大阵营之一，她们与深海进行了一场旷日持久的战争，并最终取得了胜利，将深海赶出了母世界。在数十年的重建修正后，她们终于在2200年踏上了群星之旅，而之后的故事，将由您亲自抒写。 [/b]

【高度自定义】
我们为舰娘们设计了不同的起源、物种特性、国家理念，我们鼓励您自行设计创造属于你自己的舰娘文明。
【丰富的剧情】
舰娘阵营拥有丰富完整的事件链，从刚刚踏入群星到银河之主，你都能体验到各种各样的事件与挑战。
【苍青幻影与Project-S】
舰娘拥有2条完全不同的飞升路线，每一条都拥有特殊的剧情与独立的科技。
【好感度与誓约】
每一位舰娘领袖都拥有好感度与誓约系统，她将会为您的舰娘领袖提供强大的BUFF。部分特殊领袖甚至有专属的剧情（群星GAL）
[hr][/hr]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1845920402463047312/4A813BDA52ECFF4D189A31885FB6DC2506F73567/[/img]
[b]深海舰队与舰娘有着相同的起源，但因为在战争中落败，不得不离开母世界寻找新的家园。最终，经历了无数磨难后，她们终于东山再次，而这次，她们将会不惜一切代价捍卫属于自己的一切。 [/b]

【高度自定义】
与舰娘一样，深海也是允许大量自定义
【强大的武力】
与舰娘不同，深海舰娘以无情的效率与强悍的火力著称。她们的军事工业十分发达，任何敢与她们为敌的阵营，都会遭到最猛烈的回击。
【破冰与缄默】
通过不断发展，深海舰队也将面临对未来的选择，她们将重新拥抱感情还是成为无情冰冷的执行者....
[hr][/hr]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1845920402463047559/68C5E68AF423A4B161C3AC6E1712206BF72F7148/[/img]
[b]联合起源 [/b]
联合舰队是结合了舰娘与深海的联合政体，她们的科技水平远超一般舰娘与深海。在超维物质的帮助下，她们将揭开银河系最大的秘密并寻求救赎之路.... 

【自动化产业】
联合舰队的产业可以实现高度的自动化，几乎不需要人口。
【奇迹工程】
联合舰队拥有数十种不同且独立建模的巨型建筑，从戴森云到荣耀世界，甚至是跨星系打击武器应有尽有。同时她们的舰队也十分强大，同样拥有数十种新型飞船，甚至是遮天辟日的恒星系战舰。
[hr][/hr]
[b]天灾联合 [/b]
天灾联合舰队是游戏中最为神秘强大的存在。在游戏中，她们将以终末危机的形式出现，对舰娘与深海文明进行最终的考验。

[hr][/hr]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1845920402463047853/BCCECB60F85683C86045524BB7C255CA08A14D05/[/img]
除开阵营中的专属事件，我们还提供了大量通用内容。

【战利品商店】
出售各种奇奇怪怪但强力商品的战利品商店，无论是资源、科技、BUFF甚至是誓约用的戒指，你都可以在这里找到
【利维坦与特殊事件】
我们制作了很多新奇的利维坦与特殊事件，通过击败或者探索，了解它们的故事，获得丰厚的奖励！
【舰娘堕落帝国】
幻梦余烬与沉默舰队是本MOD专属堕落帝国，她们的故事与特殊事件，等待你去体验。
【舰娘大可汗】
在游戏中期崛起的天灾势力，你能否击败她们“战无不胜”的垃圾做的舰队？

除了以上这些！还有更多！！请在游戏中发掘她们！！！


[h2]最后，欢迎订阅我们的附属MOD与MOD推荐集合（请自行筛选你需要的内容）[/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2027015321][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1845920402463313168/2742056D359929B4D2FC6CEBD4DE303B0A6F8110/[/img][/url]

选择舰娘MOD专属船模！同时联合天灾也会被替换为这些炫酷的模型。

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2461014769][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/999179622119870505/EF6D735358EC76E28AAEC484A624FF04EF3220BC/[/img][/url]
夸特帝国：
极具挑战的联动模组，帕里特起源剧情的延续！

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=828731704][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1011562931204692584/E936F0E787D38DB9FDA18630CB746DE960F118B9/[/img][/url]
涅槃圣权：
更高更强大的数值，更具有挑战性的AI，全新独特的阵营，在AI上进行联动！

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1970249743][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1845920402463349893/B8EE65C2D02F825B49F7E40353A134B23F3F3142/[/img][/url]
舰娘顾问语音：
全群星最优质的顾问语音MOD，每一位语音都聘请了原CV专门录制，与四位舰娘一同开始群星之旅！
[hr][/hr]


[hr][/hr]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3387068412]原版运行优化[/url]
原版运行优化：显著提升舰娘运行效率，带来更加流畅稳定的游戏体验！
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1595876588]Universal Resource Patch[/url]
收容大量mod的战略资源，如果订阅的MOD导致战略资源冲突不显示，请订阅该MOD

PSIONIC海豹的推荐MOD，包含部分例如更多飞升槽、自动探索开局等一系列功能性MOD。（但请自行筛选需要的MOD）

title: Expanded Colours
description:
[b][i]4.1.* Compatible[/i][/b]

[h1]Expanded Colours Version 2.0[/h1]
This mod augments the vanilla palette to a total of [i]195 colours[/i] in various ranges.
Additionally, all the new colours are usable by the AI.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[b]This mod is savegame, achievement, ironman, and multiplayer compatible[/b]

It can be used in multiplayer even if other players do not have it, but players without the mod will see the added colours as black. Vanilla colours are included, so any flags using them will show up normally.

This mod [i]should[/i] be compatible with other mods and Stellaris updates as long as the flag creation interface or the colour files aren't modified / updated.
If you have problems with this mod, try disabling all your other mods first, just in case there is a conflict.

[h2]Methodology[/h2]
In contrast to the previous version, these colours have been picked strategically.
Firstly, all colours were chosen in OKLab colour space, to ensure that the resulting colours cover the perceptual space efficiently. Secondly, I've filled the grid in groups, to further control the coverage. [b]These groups include the vanilla colours, instead of separating them as their own group.[/b]
Starting from the top:
[list]
    [*]Pastel colours (3 rows)
    [*]Bright colours  (4 rows)
    [*]Vibrant colours (1 row)
    [*]Dark colours (3 rows)
    [*]Pale colours (2 rows)
    [*]Misc colours (1 row)
    [*]Grayscale (1 row)
[/list]

Randomizable combos were created such that the colour pairs have a minimum perceptual distance to avoid monochromatic flags, but otherwise they are fully random.

[h2]Legacy versions[/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3490361056]Legacy colours[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1889425708]Pre-launcher rework (2.3)[/url]

[hr][/hr]
You are free to use this mod for reference for your own mods, but if you use the existing files with no edits, please give credit.

Suggestions and feedback is welcome as well.

title: ISBS: Doomsday Weapons & Ships
description:
[h1][b]Improved Space Battles - expand your mid / late game with 5 new super-capital class ships, over 50 new technologies and 11 doomsday weapons - including planet destroying, star system destroying and anti-fleet super-weapons.[/b][/h1]

[quote]
[h1][b]Initial Compatibility Hotfix for 2.1. Sincere apologies for going MIA![/b][/h1]
[/quote]

Improved Space Battles (ISB) attempts to improve both the visuals and gameplay of Stellaris's space battles. This is the standalone balance portion of ISB and contains only the additional ship classes and doomsday weapons, without the gameplay changes. For the best experience, use this mod with  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=692028161]Improved Space Battles [Graphics][/url] which focuses on graphical tweaks for more epic space battles. [b]This mod is designed for long games in huge (1000+) star galaxies. However you can lower the mod's difficulty for smaller galaxies through Empire policies.[/b]

[url=http://gfycat.com/IncompleteBarrenFly][img]https://i.imgur.com/v6uL8nI.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://gfycat.com/VagueHarshAmericanshorthair][img]https://i.imgur.com/S6bIvyP.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://gfycat.com/PoliteAbsoluteBovine][img]https://i.imgur.com/loGIW3v.jpg[/img][/url]

[quote]
[h1][b]Looking for a challenge?[/b][/h1]
Try out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=693447055]ISB:Balance[/url] which includes massive buffs to FEs, AEs and Crises for an exciting mid - late game.

[h1][b]Courtesy of Crusader Vanguard:[/b][/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=830544109] NSC Compatibility Patch [/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=830546181] NSC / RS Compatibility Patch [/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=945020813] RS Compatibility Patch [/url]

[/quote]
[quote]
[b][url=http://i.imgur.com/B4Co1cF.jpg]New Technologies Overview (v1.5 updated)[/url]

[url=http://gfycat.com/IncompleteBarrenFly]Ragnarok[/url]
[url=https://streamable.com/fw13]Firing the Spear of Cassius[/url]

[url=https://gfycat.com/VagueHarshAmericanshorthair]Erebus, Super-Carrier[/url]
[b][url=https://gfycat.com/TemptingRewardingBelugawhale]Micro Jumping[/url][/b](add-on mod linked at bottom)

[url=https://gfycat.com/PoliteAbsoluteBovine]Avatar destroying a planet[/url]
[url=https://gfycat.com/SaltyEnviousAmericanwigeon]Avatar blown up[/url]
[url=http://imgur.com/a/Jtjj1]Avatar Construction Guide[/url]

[url=https://gfycat.com/ValidEducatedBaiji]Destroying a star system[/url]
[/b]
[/quote]
[quote]
[h1]Features[/h1]

[h1][b][url=https://gfycat.com/VagueHarshAmericanshorthair]Ragnarok[/url][/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] A massive super-capital class ship grown from the organic matter discovered near our galactic core. While we do not fully understand the ship or its technologies, we are able to exert some manner of control. It is able to deploy both the Spear of Longinus and Spear of Cassius doomsday weapons.
[*]The Ragnarok starts out in an infantile stage. In order to grow its organic core to maturity, it has to consume 40 planets through use of the Spear of Longinus.
[*] You may only own one Ragnarok at any time.

title: Expanded Stellaris Ascension Perks
description:
[h1][b]Stellaris 4.4.*[/b] /// [/h1]
[h1]Intro>[/h1]
This mod adds 45 new Ascension Perks to the game. Designate your planets as Forge Worlds or Garden Worlds, find new deposits and unlock special rare technologies to be discovered. Specialize your empire based on ideology and much more!

[b]Featured in Odin Gamings top 10 Stellaris Mods of 2017![/b]

I have tried to keep away from "Boring" stuff (like +5 Starbase Capacity). There are still a few perks like that, but I have tried to make things as fun as possible. A lot of the perks have more to them than what is written in the description (It would have become far too long!).

[h1]Example Perks[/h1]
[list]
[*] Deep Core Mining: Lets you discover new mineral deposits on a planet, but reduces its happiness and habitability.
[*] Forge Worlds: Let's you designate a planet as a forge world, increasing production capabilities while giving other penalties.[/list]

[h1]Important Information - Please Read[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]There is a Delta Dev branch version of this mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2976573664]found here[/url]. 
[*] The full list of perks and their effect can be found on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1067631798/7056650397734049546/]this description page[/url].
[*] Please read the "Providing Bug Reports" section before providing a bug report.
[*] Please provide feedback and bug reports for my tradition perk mod at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=946222466&tscn=1631885041]that mod's page[/url].[/list]

[h1]Expanded Stellaris Traditions[/h1]
Check out Girion's other mod, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=946222466]Expanded Stellaris Traditions[/url] which adds 44 new Tradition Trees to the game! Alternatively, for those that want the latest (sometimes experimental) features faster, please check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3181487775]Expanded Stellaris Traditions (Delta)[/url] instead.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] 44 new tradition trees added.
[*] Extensive use of tradition swapping. 
[list]
[*] Playing a hive-mind, or an authoritarian dictatorship? In that case, liberal democracy style traditions will be swapped out for more fitting stuff (what exactly depends on what you play).
[*] Not using Robots? Traditions giving bonuses to robots will give different bonuses. Same things for slavery, megastructures etc.
[*] Theme changing with your empire. The Order tree will be very different for a Slaving Autocracy and an Egalitan empire.[/list]
[*] Built-in AI support. Either the AI is able to use a tradition properly, or they will have an easier-to-use swap giving a corresponding bonus.
[*] Traditions do not only contains passive bonuses, more interesting effects, such as:
[list]
[*] Bonuses depending on your playstyle, conditioned on fulfilling special conditions. 
[*] Adding new buildings, edicts, jobs, policies, technologies, traits, etc.
[*] Gain resources for destroying enemy ships, raid neighbouring empires, pick virtues for your leaders, and much more interesting stuff.[/list]
[*] Unique icons, tree layouts, and well-written flavour texts for all traditions.
[/list]

[h1]Providing Bug Reports[/h1]
Please report all bugs that you find. However, it would be very helpful if you could follow these steps to make it easier for me to fix the bug:
[list]
[*]Please report your bugs [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1067631798/1457328927847712765/]at this discussion page[/url]. I can't always fix bugs as they are reported, and if you only report them in the main discussion they very easily get swamped by other comments by the time I can look at them.
[*] Please describe what is the problem. "X doesn't work" is not very helpful.
[*] Please provide a screenshot, it is very helpful.
[*] Please try and confirm whenever the bug persists with only this mod present.[/list]

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
[list][*]In case you need more ascension slots try [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1890399946]this mod[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2458655721]this other mod[/url].
[*]This mod is now compatible with a lot of ascension perk mods out there.
[*]If you want to fix the Paradox limit to ascension paths or further compatibility between tradition and ascension perks, I can recommend my other mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821711162]! Sartek Tradition - Ascension Perk Merger[/url].
[*] For modders, you can use the folowing scripted variable: @esap_sartek_mod_active = 0
[/list]

[h1]Translations[/h1]
ESAP has English native support and has localization set in place for translators, translations are handled in separate mods that have to go below ESAP in the mod load order, here is a list of translations so far:
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177]French[/url] (Thank you Stern)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2609265227]Japanese[/url] (Thank you Rio_Mizuhoshi)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2131014154]Chinese[/url] (Thank you Doves)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2696538662]Russian[/url] (Thank you knon_20)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2904651801]Italian[/url] (Thank you Rahl81)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2982101212]Korean[/url] (Thank you joy9708)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3281293498]Spanish[/url] (Thank you Knights of Strategy)
[/list]

[h1]Giving Input[/h1]
The vast majority of all playthroughs with this mod are not done by me, to make it as good as possible I need all the input I can get. Please come with any input that you have, a large amount of the input I receive actually have real input on this mod. Please note that there are appropriate pages at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/discussions/1067631798]the discussions tab of this mod[/url] for each type of input.
[list]
[*] [b]Balance:[/b] While top priority has been to come up with interesting themes for all perks I do believe this is not incompatible with having a balanced mod. All input on which perks you find too strong to weak is appreciated.
[*] [b]Bugs:[/b] I test everything that I upload. However, this mod gets quite complex and in certain cases, there might be a bug. There is also a lot of stuff in it so I've probably missed a few things as well. Right now it should be quite solid, with the next update there might be a few new ones though. Please report!
[*] [b]Spelling:[/b] English is not my first language (however I try to check everything with a spell checker). If you find some error, tell me and I will fix it.
[*] [b]Suggestions:[/b] Have any cool ideas for new perks? I am open to suggestions. No promises but if you have something I will think about it at least.
[*] [b]Themes:[/b] Do you like the themes of the perks? Are there any one of them that you don't think is clear enough? I think the RP part is important, so please come with any input you have on this. Maybe you have an idea for a more fitting name for a tree or tradition?[/list]

[h1]Thanks[/h1]
[b]The guys in the Stellaris Mod Discord Channel[/b]
For helping me with various things.
[b]Odin Gaming[/b]
For featuring this mod.
[b]The creators of CWTools for Paradox Modding[/b]
This seriously makes the modding process three times easier.

[*]Please report your bugs [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1067631798/1457328927847712765/]at this discussion page. I can't always fix bugs as they are reported, and if you only report them in the main discussion they very easily get swamped by other comments by the time I can look at them.
[*] Please describe what is the problem. "X doesn't work" is not very helpful.
[*] Please provide a screenshot, it is very helpful.
[*] Please try and confirm whenever the bug persists with only this mod present.

Compatibility
[*]In case you need more ascension slots try [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1890399946]this mod or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2458655721]this other mod.
[*]This mod is now compatible with a lot of ascension perk mods out there.
[*]If you want to fix the Paradox limit to ascension paths or further compatibility between tradition and ascension perks, I can recommend my other mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821711162]! Sartek Tradition - Ascension Perk Merger.
[*] For modders, you can use the folowing scripted variable: @esap_sartek_mod_active = 0


Translations
ESAP has English native support and has localization set in place for translators, translations are handled in separate mods that have to go below ESAP in the mod load order, here is a list of translations so far:

[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177]French (Thank you Stern)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2609265227]Japanese (Thank you Rio_Mizuhoshi)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2131014154]Chinese (Thank you Doves)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2696538662]Russian (Thank you knon_20)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2904651801]Italian (Thank you Rahl81)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2982101212]Korean (Thank you joy9708)
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3281293498]Spanish (Thank you Knights of Strategy)


Giving Input
The vast majority of all playthroughs with this mod are not done by me, to make it as good as possible I need all the input I can get. Please come with any input that you have, a large amount of the input I receive actually have real input on this mod. Please note that there are appropriate pages at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/discussions/1067631798]the discussions tab of this mod for each type of input.

[*] Balance: While top priority has been to come up with interesting themes for all perks I do believe this is not incompatible with having a balanced mod. All input on which perks you find too strong to weak is appreciated.
[*] Bugs: I test everything that I upload. However, this mod gets quite complex and in certain cases, there might be a bug. There is also a lot of stuff in it so I've probably missed a few things as well. Right now it should be quite solid, with the next update there might be a few new ones though. Please report!
[*] Spelling: English is not my first language (however I try to check everything with a spell checker). If you find some error, tell me and I will fix it.
[*] Suggestions: Have any cool ideas for new perks? I am open to suggestions. No promises but if you have something I will think about it at least.
[*] Themes: Do you like the themes of the perks? Are there any one of them that you don't think is clear enough? I think the RP part is important, so please come with any input you have on this. Maybe you have an idea for a more fitting name for a tree or tradition?

Thanks
The guys in the Stellaris Mod Discord Channel
For helping me with various things.
Odin Gaming
For featuring this mod.
The creators of CWTools for Paradox Modding
This seriously makes the modding process three times easier.

title: Tidy Tradition
description:
4.4✔️; English✔️; 日本語✔️; Italiano✔️; French✔️

The author cannot speak Japanese and Italian, so the translation of these two languages needs to subscribe to the following mods:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2933237667&tscn=1677307562]日本語[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2918351149&searchtext=tidy]Italian[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177]French[/url]

[h2]Tidy Tradition[/h2]

[h2]Detailed Introduction[/h2]
There are too many traditions to introduce, so I just picked a few interesting ones

[b]Change / Update Tradition[/b]
Allows transfer important planet modifiers, such as those obtained after defeating Leviathan, reduce the time and cost of environmental transformation, reduce the influence and unity cost of decisions.

[b]Administration Tradition[/b]
Reduce Empire Size, reduce the punishment brought by Empire Size, and allows the choice of whether to change ethics and national flag before becoming the Galaxy Empire

[b]Industry Tradition[/b]
Add building slot, increase alloy output, increase the construction speed of megastructures, and provide more ship sections

[b]Liberation Tradition[/b]
Reduce pop demotion time. When the average happiness of a planet is <= 40%, rebellion may break out, giving more political power to the bottom pop
Complete this tradition to add modifier "A Community with a Shared Future for the Galaxy", the more non-dependent countries that complete this tradition, the stronger the effect
Unlock Communist Federation

[b]Wisdom Tradition[/b]
Unlock artifact actions, allows the research of three major dark matter technologies at the expense of dark matter and minor artifacts

[b]Agendas[/b]
All the traditions can unlock an agenda!

[h2]Expand Mod[/h2]

[b]Expand tradition slots and ap slots: [/b]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2783854571]Tidy Tradition: 15 tradition slots+16 ap slots[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2783854641]Tidy Tradition: 23 tradition slots+24 ap slots[/url]

A year ago, there was a contest to make archaeology event mod in my community.
This mod is made as a reward for the contest.

It adds 19 archaeology stories written by the community members.

Check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1999328266] Precursor Story Pack [/url] mod for 'Mod Making Phase 5' stories.

- A Bedroom Planet
- The First Music
- Dawn star is coming
- Ship of Theseus

- The Place where history has preserved (Displayed as: Kessler Syndrome)
- Geocentrism (Displayed as: Fixed World) (Includes: a Colossus Weapon, Geo-centralizer)
- Haunting Spectre (Displayed as: Ruined World)
- Rain World

- Parasite Machine

- [Precursor] The Sless Alliance
- [Precursor] Egalitarian Fallen Empire, The Coprean Constitution
- [Precursor] The Astanine

title: Real Space - System Scale
description:
[b]Real Space - System Scale v 1.8.9[/b]

[b]This version is compatible with patch 4.4 Pegasus.[/b]

[b]Attention! This mod should be located in the launcher list, lower than the main Real Space mod![/b]

[table]
[tr]
[th][url=boosty.to/annatar108] [img]https://imgur.com/ZEBNNJB.png[/img][/url][/th]
[th][url=discord.gg/tCpXcNs] [img]https://imgur.com/K3aIvKq.png[/img][/url][/th]
[th][url=vk.com/realspacemod] [img]https://imgur.com/dwMExTS.png[/img][/url][/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

Many were waiting for this and it happened! I am sure that even those who do not plan to use it will be happy with this mod. Now the scaling system in Real Space is a separate submode!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EjzuguR.png[/img]

The scale of the planets and the solar system was increased.
The relative speed of movement of ships in the system is preserved.
The camera settings in the system have been changed.
Space battles were also adapted for the new scale of the system.

NEW: The scale has been significantly changed compared to the previous version. Pay attention to the ships when approaching the camera. Now it is more like the original, but with a more realistic scale. For those who did not like the previous version, I recommend trying this one.

title: UI Overhaul Dynamic - Ascension Slots
description:
For [b]4.4 ✔️[/b] - Compatible with save games.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ugRr97n.png[/img]
It does [b]require[/b] the main mod to run.

This is a submod for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1623423360]UI Overhaul Dynamic[/url] that increases the ascension slots from 8 to a maximum 100, depending on user selection. The vanilla UI can only display about 18, so I don't advise using it without my UI mod.

[list][*]At the start of a new game, or with a save game which hasn't used this mod before, you'll be given an event which allows you to pick between a nice range of values that determines how many ascension slots that can be unlocked with the repeating technology.
[*]This event also checks for the amount of tradition categories, and disables the ones that would make you exceed the 100 slot limt.
[*]The tradition window will always display all 100 ascension slot, but the technology is restricted to the event.[/list]

Tested to work in singleplayer and on save games, but yet to be tested in multiplayer.

Console command to open limit event:
[code]event ui_overhaul_qhd_ascension.10[/code]
(Should allow you to change max limit throughout the game.)

Tech ID is:
[code]ui_tech_ascension_theory_repeatable[/code]


[h1]Supported Mods:[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1414213153]Classic Advanced Ascension
[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1199002146]Reworked Advanced Ascension
[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1693982756]Unique Ascension Perks[/url]
[*] Any other tradition mod that doesn't alter the ascension slot amount.
[/list]

title: Additional Traits
description:
Stellaris is a game with infinite possibilities and an infinite potential.
So why not start by adding more species traits to your game, for a more diverse galaxy ?
This allow you different options and more varied handicaps .. and advantages.
One of the objectives of this mod is to provide a balanced assortment of traits, fitting as much for multiplayer as well as singleplayer.

[h1]Last update :[/h1] 
Updated for 4.4.

Have fun playing with this mod and remember to give us feedback, so we can balance this mod better and faster.

[h1]Content :[/h1]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/681576508/3288067088115980313/]You can find the full list here.[/url]

The traits added in-game by Additional Traits are :
[h1] - Organics[/h1]
23 Handicaps
35 Avantages

[h1]- Presapients[/h1]
5 traits
 
[h1] - Robotics[/h1]
10 Handicaps
10 Avantages

The traits marked by a * are using an event which check at game start, when you modify your species and once a year that your main species still possess the trait. These traits apply to the whole empire.
Hateful, Violent, Aggressive, Extremely Aggressive, Competitive, Belligerent and Sociable traits gives opinion modifiers, like Charismatic and Repugnant does.

Future versions may integrate more traits. Don't hesitate to propose your ideas, we are always interested.
[url=https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/index.php?threads/mod-additional-traits.925274/]The forum discussion and the direct download link for the (very old) mods can be found here.[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1310130433]Additional Traits : Before the Apocalypse[/url] : 1.9.1 version of the mod, for those who want to play before the Cherryh/Apocalypse update.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1586449398]Additional Traits : Niven[/url] : 2.1 version of the mod, for those which liked tiles on their planets.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1886475687]Additional Traits : Wolfe[/url] : 2.3 version of the mod, before the new launcher.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3476322263]Additional Traits : Circinus[/url] : 3.14 version of the mod, before the new population system of 4.0.

[h1]Languages :[/h1]

This mod have currently translations in :
- English
- French
- Russian
- Polish
- German
- Portuguese
- Spanish
- Chinese
Some of these translations are old, inacurrate or incomplete. All help is welcome to make it complete.


[h1]Compabilities :[/h1]

This mod overwrite the files 02_species_traits_basic_characteristics.txt, 03_species_traits_presapients.txt, 04_species_traits.txt and 05_species_traits_robotic.txt
This mod is included in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1670045745]Rtt Russian Localization[/url] modpack.

[h1]Contributors :[/h1]

Graphics : Meltup, Machinekng, Dskod1

Coding : Granhyt, Black_Imperator, TehT, Sriseru, Gerishnakov, Anitachall

Translators :
English : Ophidian, Target Practice
French : Granhyt
Polish : Kazmyl
German : Aqua, EselNase, XeNoN, Noobier
Portuguese : Chariman Isaac Buell, Aranha Maluco
Spanish : OBV, Valgarv
Russian : God Of Hyperdeath, Arikotomoshi, Resident-tt
Chinese : Anold_GH

Special thanks to Meltup of his help, providing these great new icons, his constant ideas, advices, feedback. Special thanks also to black_imperator for his help getting these events working, his explanations, and the impressive compilation of effects, modifiers and the like.
Thanks to Dracarys47 for the opinion modifiers explanation.
And of course, thank to everyone for their inputs, ideas, advices and feedback.
If we forgot someone, just ask us to correct it. :)


[h1]Free use :[/h1]

Any/All parts of this may be used by anyone else for any reason, as long as it is in compliance with the Rules for User Made Mods and Edits of PDS games. If you do use any part of this mod, please give us credit where applying.​
Feedback and ideas are really appreciated. So thank you in advance.

title: Downscaled Ships
description:
[b]Compatible with 3.2.*[/b]

[h1][b]Compatibility patches:[/b][/h1]
[b]DLC:[/b]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2662937312]-Aquatic ship set DLC[/url]

[b]Mods:[/b]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1454986404]-AI ship set.[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1725243949]-Sins of the Prophets.[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1370474221]-EAC: At War Patch[/url]

[h1][b]Graphical mod only. No gameplay changes.[/b][/h1]

This mod fixes a couple of problems with the default visuals: 
[list]
[*]Fleets are too tightly packed and ships often clip through each other. Once you have a big and especially if you have allies, you can't even tell one ship from another. Not to mention the far bigger mess that two large fleets crashing into each other creates. Downscaling every ship type fixes this.

[*]You don't get a proper sense of capital ships and escort ships because the scale between ship classes increases more or less linearly and corvettes for example are just too big compared to battleships. This mod creates a clear distinction in scale between corvettes/destroyers and cruisers/battleships. 

[*]Turrets are scaled down relative to ship sizes to make ships feel bigger.

[*]Engine exhaust trails and some weapon effects are scaled down as well.

[*]Also rescaled: starbases, habitats, stations, defense platforms and various creatures and objects around the galaxy.
[/list]

No trails mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=886734961

[h1][b]Reporting scaling issues:[/b][/h1]
-Use the console command "tweakergui entity.names" in-game and give me the name of the ship model.

[h1][b]Compatibility/information:[/b][/h1]
-Multiplayer: every player needs to have this mod enabled.
-Not achievement compatible.
-This mod is not made for improving performance.
[b]-Mod compatibility:[/b] mods that add new ship models need a compatibility fix. Otherwise they will look bigger compared to the vanilla ships. See the list below or search the workshop (not all patches are listed here).

[h1][b]Requesting additional compatibility patches:[/b][/h1]
-It's not complicated to make one but it is tedious ([URL=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/687037851/1479856439033391798/]see the tutorial here[/URL]). I recommend making one yourself by looking at how the other compatibility patches were made.

[h1][b]Change log:[/b][/h1]
10/12/2017: fixed oversized ship preview images
23/02/2018: rescaled titans, colossi, starbases
24/02/2018: rescaled mining/research/terraforming/observation stations, defense platforms, pirate ships and stations as well as other neutral things around the galaxy, laser beam width
15/12/2018: fixed L gate builder ship sizes

[quote][b]Donations:[/b] [URL=http://www.paypal.me/chondrite126]https://www.paypal.me/chondrite126[/URL][/quote]

title: Star Trek: New Horizons
description:
[h1][b]Star Trek: New Horizons[/b][/h1]
	[url=https://discord.gg/d2RtTCk][h1][b] 4.4.6 Compatible  WIP [/b][/h1][/url]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4nxtkFwH/anniversary-steam.png[/img]


[quote]
[b][h2]10 Years of Star Trek: New Horizons[/h2]

May 20, 2016. The first workshop upload of STNH went live, few days after Stellaris itself came out. We had no idea what we were doing or where this was going to go.

Ten years later, we're still here. Still patching, still building, still arguing about ship classifications. And you're still here too. That's what makes this whole thing matter.

Thank you. To every single one of you who downloaded, played, gave feedback, reported bugs, made art, wrote stories, joined the Discord, or just dropped a comment over the years. STNH has always been a community project, and it only stays alive because the community keeps showing up.
Here's to the next ten.

Gman[/b]
[/quote]



[hr][/hr]

	[h2][b]Features[/b][/h2]
	[list]
[*] Canonical static/random maps incl. low-end PC and BOTF style.
[*] About 100 canon races with animated portraits.
[*] New district system overhauling economy and planet specialisation.
[*] Full ship sets for 70+ races (UE, UFP, Terran, Klingon, Romulan, Cardassian, Dominion, Gorn, Borg, pirates etc.).
[*] Iconic ships like: Sovereign Enterprise, Dominion Super BB, Voth City, Charon mothership.
[*] Unique flagships with tech, exploration and combat roles.
[*] Playable Borg with unique story, tech, ships, components, events and assimilation.
[*] 800+ unique ship models.
[*] 1000+ events, 1M+ words.
[*] Many megastructures: Suliban Helix, Argus Array, Borg Unicomplex.
[*] New traditions, edicts, decisions, policies.
[*] Innovative ship designer with thousands of components.

title: Star Wars Empire Ships Legacy
description:
should work with 2.0

[h1]Star Wars Empire Ship Pack v.1.5[/h1]

[h1] Do not redistribute the mod without permission, nor use mod content in another mod even if it is only the asset. files without asking first![/h1]

Version for Stellaris 2.6 can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2019865539

Version for Stellaris 1.9 can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1413109542


This ship pack allows you to play with the Galactic Empire Fleet from the Imperial Civil War era.


[h1]How to use:[/h1]
You need to start a new game with the prescripted Faction (Event Galactic Empire 2). You can edit it and save them how you like. Every ship after Destroyer has its own class, you wont see them in the vanilla ship sizes.
Use the Prescipted Race only for the Full version not the LITE or any other shippack! 

The Annihilator works like the ships in the Fractal Ships Mod

For the LITE version (Replacing only Models) you just need to use the Empire Lite ships, the same as other shippacks in the workshop.

For the SSD you need first one of these two mods:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=720237457 or 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=693447055
Then you need to do the Titan Tech Chain from the Mods and you need the Empire Dreadnought Tech
[spoiler]https://s22.postimg.io/40cf7lwwh/needed_SSD_techs.png [/spoiler]


[h1]Read the FAQ![/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/741930256/343785380902722968/  F.A.Q

[h1]Credits[/h1]

Warb_null - for allowing me to use his models and textures 
http://www.moddb.com/members/warb-null
Jeroenimo - for allowing me to use his models and textures 
http://www.moddb.com/members/jeroenimo
Yuuzhan Vong at War Team for the free model release
http://www.moddb.com/mods/yuuzhan-vong-at-war
ArvisTaljik - letting me use his Models and Textures
http://www.moddb.com/members/arvistaljik
JarJarThomas for his Interdictor Cruiser upload on scifi3d
http://scifi3d.com/details.asp?intGenreID=10&intCatID=8&key=179


[h1] Detailed credits are moved to a .txt file in this mod zip.[/h1]


Be sure to check out Yorick´s IIC - Old Republic Ships Mod.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=750263062

title: ISBS - Living Systems
description:
Improved Space Battles Standalone - Living Systems adds life to your interstellar empire by populating it with hundreds of autonomous civilian vessels. Your systems will no longer feel empty and devoid of life as civilian vessels buzz around from planet to planet on their daily business.

[quote]
[h1][b]Initial Compatibility Hotfix for 2.1. Sincere apologies for going MIA![/b][/h1]
[/quote]

Civilian activity will grow along with your planets and economy. After your empire reaches a certain size, civilians will start to leave the system in search of new opportunities. Watch as your empire grows from a single starport to a living, thriving galactic hub!

[h1]It is [b][u]HIGHLY RECOMMENDED[/u][/b] that you use this mod in conjunction with [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=692028161]Improved Space Battles [Graphics][/url] to experience the mod as intended. This will greatly reduce the visual clutter caused by civilians.

[b][u]To safely remove the mod, set civilian density to OFF and wait 1 year before disabling it.[/u][/b][/h1]

[quote]
[h1][b][url=http://gfycat.com/WeepyInformalCaudata]Timelapse of Living Systems - 4x speed[/url][/b][/h1]

[b]Interstellar Civilian Fleet[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/9Aavm9c.jpg[/img]

[b]Billboard Advertisement Ship[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/0uzK7Pj.jpg[/img]

[b]Civilian Vessels[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Og5pRb5.jpg[/img]

[/quote]
[quote]
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adds civilians to Stellaris. Civilians represent the general population of your empire and will automatically move around within your borders.
[*] Adds over 40 different civilian ships, spawned at random to ensure each solar system looks different. Also includes Billboard advertisements within systems and interstellar fleets that will move around within your empire.
[*] Highly customisable settings (through in-game policies) to ensure you can play with minimal performance impact. [b][u]Read the policy tooltips![/u][/b]
[*] [b]It will take several years to populate your systems after enabling this mod.[/b]
[/list]

[/quote]
[quote]
[h1]General Description[/h1]

Civilians fleets are created from planets with spaceports. Once a planet grows to 4 pops or more, civilians will start leaving the planet to explore the solar system. Civilian activity increases along with the planet population - larger planets will generate much more activity within a system. 

As the planet develops, different ships such as billboard advertisements will begin to appear . When your empire grows beyond a certain size, civilians will also start leaving their original solar system and move around in your empire.

[h1]Performance[/h1]

The biggest concern I have with this mod is performance. To ensure that it is able to run on a wide variety of systems, I have added several customisation options. These options are controlled through empire policies (though you have to use "free_policies" through the console to change the same option multiple times). The following options are available:

[list]
[*]Civilian Density [Normal (default), Low, Off] : Controls the number of civilian ships spawned in player empires. Lower this to improve performance. Turning off civilian density will also disable the mod, allowing you to safely remove it after about a year of in-game time.
[*]Intra-System Billboards [Enabled (default), Disabled]: Controls the spawning of billboard advertisement ships in-game. I was unsure if people might find the ads distracting so I added an option to turn it off.
[*]Interstellar Ships [Enabled (default), Disabled]: Controls the spawning of Interstellar Civilian Fleets that move between systems.
[*]AI - Living Systems [Off (default), Contact only, All]: Controls the spawning of civilians in AI empires. Contact only means civilians will only spawn in Empires you have contact with. All means civilians will spawn in all AI empires (pretty big performance hit late game).

Feedback, suggestions or criticisms greatly appreciated!
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=750209726][b]简体中文版 - by SteRyGogO[/b][/url][/h1]

[h1][b]HUGE thanks to draft3dd for the Russian Localisation![/b][/h1]

[h1]Attribution[/h1]
Star Citizen images are taken from [url=http://starcitizen.wikia.com/wiki/Main_Page]Star Citizen Wikia[/url]
Fallout 4 images are taken from [url=http://fallout.wikia.com/wiki/Fallout_4]Fallout 4 Wiki[/url]
[/quote]


[h1][b]For an improved Stellaris experience, use this mod along with the following ISB mods, which adds 5 new super-capital class ships, over 50 new technologies and 11 doomsday weapons - including planet destroying, star system destroying and anti-fleet super-weapons.[/b][/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=692028161][img]http://i.imgur.com/PtEAVoy.jpg[/img]
[/url][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=693447055][img]https://i.imgur.com/rSwLffW.jpg[/img]
[/url][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=720237457][img]http://i.imgur.com/EBz4gq3.jpg[/img]
[/url][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=723219794][img]http://i.imgur.com/s39gHMX.jpg[/img]
[/url]

[url=http://gfycat.com/IncompleteBarrenFly][img]https://i.imgur.com/v6uL8nI.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://gfycat.com/VagueHarshAmericanshorthair][img]https://i.imgur.com/S6bIvyP.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://gfycat.com/PoliteAbsoluteBovine][img]https://i.imgur.com/loGIW3v.jpg[/img][/url]
