title: Sins of the Prophets: Stellaris
description:
Sins of the Prophets: Stellaris v0.4.0

[h1]Compatible with 4.1.*[/h1]

Come join our Discord: https://discord.gg/9durxEz

Sins of a Solar Empire's best Halo mod has come to Stellaris! 

Sins of the Prophets is an award winning and critically acclaimed mod for Sins of a Solar Empire: Rebellion. Swarms of fan requests to port the mod to Stellaris has lead to what you're about to experience! 

We've brought our high quality ships and structures from the main mod on SoaSE over to Stellaris to allow you the chance to act out all your Halo space empire building fantasies! In addition, we've partnered with lossaa of Halo Universe Human Species and Halo Covenant Species to bring you UNSC style human portraits and cities plus portraits of multiple Covenant client races, with Geoffers747 from the Halo UNSC Overhaul mod to bring you a complete UNSC namelist, with Winters from Halo Emblems to give you access to a great selection of emblems, as well as with Trace Projectile of Trace's Empire Customization to bring you Covenant and Sangheili cityscapes! A big thank you goes out to Fal' Soram, who set up the engine trails for many of our vanilla UNSC units, and taught us how to do so for the future.

If you enjoy playing with our ships in Stellaris, but desire a more visceral combat experience please come take a look at the primary mod on Sins of a Solar Empire: Rebellion at http://www.moddb.com/mods/halo-sins-of-the-prophets 

Some Covenant assets have been created in a partnership with Homefront, a Homeworld 2 Halo mod: http://www.moddb.com/mods/halo-homefront/ 

Features native support for "Aesthetic Cinematic Gameplay", "Planetary Assault Army & Ship", "Space Combat Expanded" (Carrier/Dreadnought), and "Stellar Expansion - Voidcraft". 

For a version to use with achievements and ironman mode, please see: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1431928288

For compatibility with "New Ship Classes & More" please get this patch in addition to this mod: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=840482374

For compatibility with "Realistic Ships" please get this patch in addition to this mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1437630372

For compatibility when using "Real Space - System Scale" and "Gigastructural Engineering" at the same time please get this patch in addition to this mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2465565751

For compatibility with any mod that changes the default Humanoid portrait group please get this patch in addition to this mod: 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1422287488

UNSC models:
Construction ship: Scholte
Science ship: Winter
Colony ship: Phoenix
Transport ship: Phoenix Refit
Corvette: Paris
Frigate: Charon
Destroyer: Halberd
Cruiser: Marathon
Battleship: Valiant
Titan: Infinity
Colossus: Artemis
Juggernaut: Thanatos
Mega Shipyard: Titan Factory
Fighter: C712 Longsword
Bomber: C709 Longsword

Covenant models:
Construction ship: DRA
Science ship: DAS
Colony ship: ACD 
Transport ship: DSC
Corvette/Frigate: CAR
Destroyer: CPV
Cruiser: CCS
Battleship: ORS
Titan: Esgem-pattern CAS
Colossus: DOS
Juggernaut: OSS
Mega Shipyard: Unyielding Hierophant
Fighter: Type-27 Banshee (aka. Space Banshee)
Bomber: Seraph

Do not redistribute without permission.

title: Precursor Story Pack
description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/yxxVY1MW/rate-favorite.gif[/img]
[h1] Stellaris v3.9.* Compatible [/h1]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/yNgJTMGr/1.png[/img]
There was an ancient civilization before us... this is their story.

This mod adds 3 precursor stories written by the community members.

This is last phase of my previous mod, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1993869579] Archaeology Story Pack. [/url] You can use this mod independently, or with it as you want.

[h1] Mod Making Phase 5 [/h1]
[b] [Precursor] The Sless Alliance [/b]
Six million years ago, there was a society where multiple species coexist prosperously... they called themselves the 'Sless Alliance'. How they ended up with total devastation, did their old conflicts between species finally ruined everything?

[b] [Precursor] The Coprean Constitution [/b]
There was an egalitarian fallen republic that suffered civil war a long, long time ago... they called themselves the 'Coprean Constitution'. What is the last of their civil war? Did they fail to recover from the war?

[b] [Precursor] The Astanine Empire [/b]
There is a planet where everything stops but blinking... hundred-thousand years ago, the planet's owner called themselves the 'Astanine Empire'. What is behind the story of this, and what truth is awaiting us?

title: [depracated] ! Production Revolution
description:
[h1][b]Mod version [ver240623] for [Stellaris 3.12]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2529002857]Newest Update for Current Stellaris[/url]
Manpower system that reduces pops, simplifies operations and improves optimization
Independent tech tree and new research system
The vanilla structure system has been expanded, and gameplay is expanded.[/b][/h1]

[h2]Required mods and patches：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2633921569]PR completion[/url]
Old version：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2865815969][Last major update][/url][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2409578462][3.2][/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2466621283][3.0][/url] [/h2]
[img=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2287328638862856691/D311DB0F1DFB46A732F47ECD847ADA538B51BB71/]


[h1][b]Sorting：[/b][/h1]
The lower the better

[h1][b]Compatibility:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]The manpower and pop systems can coexist, and are theoretically compatible with all mods.
[*]If there is no custom patch, the mod's new post will only receive the production efficiency bonus, and will not be absorbed by the manpower system.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2514766792&searchtext=performance]StellarStellaris[/url] is completely incompatible and will directly destroy the underlying mechanism of this mod
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2514536739]pop Theory[/url]/[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2170161138] The realm of species[/url] is completely incompatible and will cause the manpower system to collapse.
[*]All content based on [pop amount] is incompatible and requires a custom patch.
[*][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2633921569]All compatible patches[/url]
[/b][/list]

[img=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1696152607516668464/F8B9D2FD545068C6A5B58FD6870E73755057071B/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false]
[h1][b]Introduction to core functions:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Advanced Scientific Research System: An independent scientific research system, unlock the Production Revolution Technology Tree through <High-tech Point>. Completion of any common technology will give <High-Tech Points>, and there will be other ways to generate High-Tech Points in the future.
[*]Automatically unlock building slots: According to different planet types, all divisions can unlock a small amount of building slots, so the more divisions, the more buildings that can be built.
[*]Job Absorption: Only a small number of posts supported by the manpower system will remain, and the rest will be absorbed by manpower. Its economic output and function modifier will be added to the <Basic Output> of the manpower System.
[*]Production efficiency: the total output of the manpower system = basic output × production efficiency. Therefore, the higher the production efficiency, the more output of the manpower system. Production efficiency also affects the output of the pop, when it is greater than 1, the pop output will increase linearly.
[*]Activate Production Revolution: You can select <Complete Form> on the first page of the opening settings, all countries will default to Production Revolution, and all planets will be colonized to complete the transformation. If you choose <Historical Mode>, you need to unlock the Production Revolution through scientific research, and then perform planetary transformation through planetary decisions to activate the function of the Production Revolution.
[*]Unemployment conversion: The Production revolution does not allow excessive unemployment. When the unemployed exceeds a certain value, it will be automatically converted into manpower. This value is usually 1 and can be adjusted.
[/list]

[h1][b]User Guide[/b][/h1]
[list][*]For detailed instructions, please open the in-game settings panel to view.
[*]<pop> and <Manpower> can be converted into each other automatically or manually.
[*]<Position> Most of them will be absorbed if supported by the manpower system.
[*]<more manpower> or <less workshop> means higher output
[/list]

[h3]<If you have any problem with this mod, find "kasako_mods" channel here.>[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/TcqP7NFzEm][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Z8X68t.png[/img][/url]

title: Planetary Diversity - Planet View
description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif[/img]
[h1]Stellaris: 4.4.*[/h1]
[h1][url=https://discord.gg/qHuWBhaZpg]PD Discord Server[/url][/h1]

This is an add-on for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=819148835]Planetary Diversity[/url].
This is a stand-alone mod; it will work without PD.

This module does one thing: it shows more planet portraits in the planet view.  That's it. There was a lot of great art from Planetary Diversity that people didn't see.  It doesn't add any additional building slots or anything else; it's the same as vanilla.

All uninhabitable planet pictures are courtesy of Orries from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1623423360]UI Overhaul Dynamic[/url].  That mod is beautiful; I would highly recommend it.

[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1]
This 100% will NOT work with other planet view mods, including [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1623423360]UI Overhaul Dynamic[/url].  This mod is for those who want a more vanilla UI experience.  If you want more/extra building slots/something different, use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1623423360]UI Overhaul Dynamic[/url].  They are not compatible.

[h1]Click this link for the [url=https://discord.gg/qHuWBhaZpg]PD Discord Server[/url]. Please go there for FAQs, questions, comments, or bug reports.[/h1]
[h3] I'm no longer allowing comments on this workshop item due to the numerous rude messages and people not reading the mod description. Sorry to anyone who doesn't have access to Discord.[/h3]

title: Astronomical Emblem Pack
description:
[b]WORKS WITH ALL VERSIONS, WILL ALWAYS WORK WHEN OUTDATED[/b]

[b]CAN'T SCROLL THROUGH EMBLEMS?[/b]
[b]What happened?:[/b]  A [b]bug[/b] was introduced in Stellaris version 2.6.3 that removed the ability to scroll through many of the UI elements in the game. See these bug reports: 
[list]
[*]https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/stellaris-cant-scroll-through-flags.1381346/
[*]https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/muh-scroll-bars-scroll-bars-accidentally-removed-after-v2-7-still-missing.1402334/
[*]https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/when-is-paradox-going-to-fix-the-emblem-scroll-bug.1409280/
[*]https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/stellaris-2-6-3-scroll-bar-no-longer-present.1376170/
[/list]

[b]TEMPORARY SOLUTIONS:[/b]  
The easiest solution is to subscribe to the "UI Overhaul" Mod: 
https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1623423360
This mod fixes scrollbars as well as a bunch of other nice UI enhancements.

Alternatively you can use the Astronomical Emblem Pack (Smaller Groups) sub mod by Aelarion. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2212643108
Please note that this will break emblems on existing save games as the emblems are structured differently.


[hr][/hr]

600+ high quality emblems designed to match the style of vanilla emblems designed by Paradox.

[hr][/hr]

[b]||  FEATURES  ||[/b]

More than 600+ high quality emblems designed to fit seamlessly into the game.
Ironman compatible (works with achievements.)
Multiplayer compatible (all players must have the mod active.)
Compatible with all versions of Stellaris. (Even if the game says it is outdated in the future.)
Randomly generated AI empires will NOT spawn using these emblems.
Localization in all official game-supported languages.

[b]Astronomical Emblems Pack Contents[/b]
Star Wars
Star Trek
Mass Effect
Historical themes
Warhammer
Warhammer 40K
Half-Life
Homeworld
Magic the Gathering
Killzone
Fallout
Stargate
Battlestar Galactica
Warframe
Halo
Supreme Commander
Total Annihilation
Red Rising
There are also many other emblems included!

Plans for the future
More historic emblems
More geopolitical emblems
More high-quality emblems in general

[hr][/hr]

[b]||  GREETINGS AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION  ||[/b]

Hello everybody!

These high quality emblems were made by myself with custom made images/shapes, along with many images/shapes sourced from the web. Unlike many other emblem packs out there, I made this with the explicit purpose of matching as closely as possible the vanilla emblem style designed by Paradox.

I hope that you'll enjoy my work and find an emblem that matches your galactic needs.
Thanks for checking out my mod, please leave me a thumbs up and give me some feedback in the comments if you like! :)

I reserve the right to make changes to this mod. That means reoganizing, adding, removing, and changing emblems without additional notice. Thanks for your understanding. I'll try my best not to do anything that will mess with your saves.

[hr][/hr]

[b]||   TROUBLESHOOTING   ||[/b]

Experiencing problems with the mod? Try the following!

1. Unsubscribe from this mod.
2. Go to "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\281990\"
	* Your workshop folder may be somewhere else depending on
	* where you installed Steam or your default game library.
3. Locate a folder named "1302897684"
4. DELETE the entire "1302897684" folder and all it's contents.
5. Start Stellaris and verify that this mod no longer appears on your mod list.
6. Close Stellaris and the game launcher.
7. Subscribe to this mod on the Steam Workshop.
8. (Optional) Open up Stellaris properties in Steam and verify game contents.
9. Start Stellaris and verify that this mod appears on your mod list.
10. Enable mod. (Preferably with no other mods enabled - for testing.)  
11. Launch into Stellaris's main menu and check if the emblems appear ingame.

Still having problems? 

Delete Paradox Launcher database file as it may be corrupted (make a backup first):
WARNING: This will erase all saved mod lists and mod load orders.
1. Go to: %MyDocuments%\Paradox Interactive\Stellaris\
2. Delete: launcher-v2.sqlite
3. Start the Launcher (Stellaris/Paradox Launcher)
4. Select: Mods > Reload installed Mods
5. Launch into Stellaris's main menu and check if the emblems appear ingame.

[hr][/hr]

[b]||  EXTRAS   ||[/b]

Randomly Generated Empires with Astronomical Emblem Pack emblems submod!
Community made mod thanks to xnadu27
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1362054590

Product Placement Emblem Pack high quality corporate emblems for Stellaris.
Made by myself
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1307368196

This mod fixes scrollbars as well as a bunch of other nice UI enhancements.

Alternatively you can use the Astronomical Emblem Pack (Smaller Groups) sub mod by Aelarion. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2212643108
Please note that this will break emblems on existing save games as the emblems are structured differently.




600+ high quality emblems designed to match the style of vanilla emblems designed by Paradox.



||  FEATURES  ||

More than 600+ high quality emblems designed to fit seamlessly into the game.
Ironman compatible (works with achievements.)
Multiplayer compatible (all players must have the mod active.)
Compatible with all versions of Stellaris. (Even if the game says it is outdated in the future.)
Randomly generated AI empires will NOT spawn using these emblems.
Localization in all official game-supported languages.

Astronomical Emblems Pack Contents
Star Wars
Star Trek
Mass Effect
Historical themes
Warhammer
Warhammer 40K
Half-Life
Homeworld
Magic the Gathering
Killzone
Fallout
Stargate
Battlestar Galactica
Warframe
Halo
Supreme Commander
Total Annihilation
Red Rising
There are also many other emblems included!

Plans for the future
More historic emblems
More geopolitical emblems
More high-quality emblems in general



||  GREETINGS AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION  ||

Hello everybody!

These high quality emblems were made by myself with custom made images/shapes, along with many images/shapes sourced from the web. Unlike many other emblem packs out there, I made this with the explicit purpose of matching as closely as possible the vanilla emblem style designed by Paradox.

I hope that you'll enjoy my work and find an emblem that matches your galactic needs.
Thanks for checking out my mod, please leave me a thumbs up and give me some feedback in the comments if you like! :)

I reserve the right to make changes to this mod. That means reoganizing, adding, removing, and changing emblems without additional notice. Thanks for your understanding. I'll try my best not to do anything that will mess with your saves.



||   TROUBLESHOOTING   ||

Experiencing problems with the mod? Try the following!

1. Unsubscribe from this mod.
2. Go to "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\281990\"
	* Your workshop folder may be somewhere else depending on
	* where you installed Steam or your default game library.
3. Locate a folder named "1302897684"
4. DELETE the entire "1302897684" folder and all it's contents.
5. Start Stellaris and verify that this mod no longer appears on your mod list.
6. Close Stellaris and the game launcher.
7. Subscribe to this mod on the Steam Workshop.
8. (Optional) Open up Stellaris properties in Steam and verify game contents.
9. Start Stellaris and verify that this mod appears on your mod list.
10. Enable mod. (Preferably with no other mods enabled - for testing.)  
11. Launch into Stellaris's main menu and check if the emblems appear ingame.

Still having problems? 

Delete Paradox Launcher database file as it may be corrupted (make a backup first):
WARNING: This will erase all saved mod lists and mod load orders.
1. Go to: %MyDocuments%\Paradox Interactive\Stellaris\
2. Delete: launcher-v2.sqlite
3. Start the Launcher (Stellaris/Paradox Launcher)
4. Select: Mods > Reload installed Mods
5. Launch into Stellaris's main menu and check if the emblems appear ingame.



||  EXTRAS   ||

Randomly Generated Empires with Astronomical Emblem Pack emblems submod!
Community made mod thanks to xnadu27
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1362054590

Made by myself
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1307368196

title: Star Wars Weapons for Legacy version 1.9
description:
Mod version for 2.2 can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1627919748


Star Wars Weapons and Soundeffecte.

[h1] Do not redistribute the mod without permission, nor use mod content in another mod even if it is only the asset. files without asking first! The Mod will be for Legacy version 1.9 from now on, for new stuff wait for the Fallen Republic mod: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JnDLT5uFrVM&feature=youtu.be  [/h1]


[h1] What this mod adds:	[/h1]

[list]
    [*] 3 new defence point modules in green, red and blue
    [*] 2 new Flak modules in green, red and blue
    [*] 5 Turbolaser module, 3 Ion Cannon module, 3 Quadlaser module and 2 Octuplelaser module in green, red, blue
    [*] 3 Disruptor module in purple
    [*] 1 XL weapon, Conquerer Superlaser (kind of broken :( )
    [*] 4 new Concussion missile modules
    [*] 2 Ion Pulse missile modules
    [*] Support for Empire/ Rebel shippacks (Fighter/ Bomber and Patrol weapon effects)
    [*] For Green, Blue, Red and Disruptor weapons new hit and muzzle particle effects
    [*] 1 spaceport module only green
    [*] 6 Tech chains
    [*] Each module has it´s own tech
    [*] Each weapon has atleast 2 soundeffects (except defence point, octuplelaser, flak quad)
    [*] 6 Shieldhit soundeffects
    [*] 6 Hullhit soundeffects
    [*] Everything has its own icon and description
[/list]

Note: The Superlaser windup effect is broken, sound however works as it should, if you want to see it, open the command console and type: 
spawnentity sw_superlaser_windup_entity

it will stay until you reload your save.


Guide for not annoying me:
http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/741930256/152391995419802165/


[h1] How to use: [/h1]

The first Tech is the Blaster Technology (the Shippacks Full version will get the first Tech with the event) after that you can research wich weapon color you want (tech) green, red and blue. You can only research one Weapon Color! so choose wisely and only research the color you want! The purple color is the Disruptor weapon, you wont get it at the start and it is rare. 

For the first weapon you need a color and Light Turbolaser Tech.

Thanks to shuulleech you can now choose wich weapon color you want, if you get Blastertech!


Credits:
Laser Mesh and Textures are from Jeronimo and Megabalta
Particle Textures are from Jeroenimo´s mod Empire at war: RE
Octuple and Quadlaser sounds from Jeroenimo´s mod Empire at war: RE
shuulleech for the Color choosing event
Sounds from EAW and DICE Battlefront
Some pictures are from Fractalsponges render
Russian translation by: PLAY YOURSELF and friends

Sound and Picture Copyright belongs to LucasArts and Disney.

title: UI Overhaul Dynamic - Extended Topbar
description:
For [b]4.4 ✔️[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/txc9Oaf.png[/img]

A submod for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1623423360]UI Overhaul Dynamic[/url] that overhauls the resources displayed on the top toolbar. Doesn't require any other mods, and can be used even without the parent mod. 
[list]
[*] Minimum resolution width is 1600px (can be used with lower widths when using UI scaling, but not recommended).
[*] Displays each research type individually, instead of having a combined number and a dropdown menu, but only the user is playing on a resolution width equal-to or higher than 1920px.
[*] Displays strategic and rare resources as individual resource entries, but doesn't remove them from the dropdown list.
[*] Adds minor artifacts as an individual resource.
[*] Plays the correct sound if resource is set to open a window. 🔊
[/list]
If you want end game crisis resources in the topbar:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3090328185]Extended Topbar for DLCs[/url]


Compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1595876588]Universal Resource Patch[/url].


[h1]📑 Load Order 📑[/h1]
[olist]
[*]UI Overhaul Dynamic
[*]UI Overhaul Dynamic - Extended Topbar
[/olist]

title: Ultimate Technologies
description:
Have you ever felt constrained by military advances and economic growth?
Inalterable planets and negative modifiers. Insecure borders, pirates plunder and angry populations.
Or do you just feel like the graphics could be taken up a notch and the weapons could use some more flair?

This is your ONE MOD TO RULE THEM ALL, my friend!
Incredible new technologies, exceptional traits, powerful edicts and decisions, booming economy, remarkable terraforming ability, formidable armies, and COOOOLEST weapons.
With all these amazing breakthroughs, you can effortlessly create a paradisiacal universe that's tailored just for you.
A perfect world starts NOW!

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[h1]- Technologies -[/h1]
With cutting-edge scientific exploration, an array of revolutionary technologies offers you commanding new edicts, military components, and infrastructure endeavors. Each of them brings their own unique benefits to your empire!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/924990631/1741102632994450163/] click here to see the details [/url]

[h1]- Economy -[/h1]
There are also many awe-inspiring buildings unlocked through advanced technologies that can provide you with everything you could possibly require, including strategic resources. Construct these impressive edifices to transform and elevate your planets!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/924990631/1741102632994461996/] click here to see the details [/url]

[h1]- Edicts & Decisions -[/h1]
Unlocking edicts bring tremendous benefits to the entire nation, but they come with a high price tag due to their sheer power. In addition, planetary decisions offer you exceptional customization options. Take "Geological Reconstruction" for instance, it offers the exciting prospect of adjusting the overall size of a planet. Plus, with the right choices, you can eliminate most of the negative modifiers on your planets.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/924990631/1741102632994452907/] click here to see the details [/url]

[h1]- Terraform -[/h1]
Practically every rocky planet has the potential to transform into a thriving habitat with the aid of groundbreaking technologies such as "Geological Reconstruction" and "Edenization."
All barren planets can transform into thriving havens with tremendous energy. Transforming molten and toxic planets into fertile ones requires first converting them into barren planets and then beginning the process of "Edenization." Frozen planets can terraform directly into an arctic planet.
Although "Edenization" may seem all-powerful, even "Edenization" has its limitations; there are certain planets that are either too large or too small to be terraformed.

[h1]- Armies - (only in expand patch)[/h1]
Elite warrior, ferocious war machines designed for devastation, even bring forth the mighty "Godzilla" and transendent "Avatar" into battle!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/924990631/1741102632994465226/] click here to see the details [/url]

[h1]- Weapons & Utilities - (only in expand patch)[/h1]
And last but not least, check out our absolutely mind-blowing Ultimate Weapons! Every single weapon in this mod is an absolute powerhouse, boasting its own set of unique graphics and effects. Every single combat encounter is like a full-on fireworks display, so be sure to have a pair of shades on hand because you're definitely going to need them!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/924990631/1741102632994465226/] click here to see the details [/url]

[h1]- Expand Patch -[/h1]
To maximize the level of customization options. The MAIN MOD does NOT contain ship components, weapon modules and armies. Instead, there are THREE expansion patches for you to choose from, each with their own unique strengths and specifically designed to suit your individual preferences:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2039554470] Ultimate Weaponry (Lite) [/url]
If you're a vanilla game enthusiast and want to spice up the military options without toppling game balance, this LITE patch is the best option for you. The weapon power is pretty much on par with vanilla game and it's accessible to everyone.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2038973356] Ultimate Weaponry (Standard) [/url]
If you're a devoted mod player hungry for some wickedly powerful weapons to conquer those tough foes, then look no further! This STANDARD patch is absolutely perfect for you. The weapon power may not be overwhelmingly high, but it will undoubtedly give you immense pleasure.

Still not feeling strong enough? Here is the CHEAT option: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1374229669] Ultimate Weaponry (Restriction Break) [/url] Since it's a cheat patch, there's no way AI can get their hands on these epic weapons! Usually I wouldn't go for this one because the crazy amount of power just takes away from the excitement of the game. But if you're itching to take on some crazy end game mod with some serious firepower, this patch will give you the edge you need to slay the behemoth.

[h1]-Localisation Patch -[/h1]
Build-in Chinese & German localisation, you won't need additional patches.
Special thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Lucanoria] Lucanoria [/url] for doing the amazing German translation.
Japanese localisation (special thanks to @Timil): [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2052438865] [JP localize patch] Ultimate technologies [/url]
Russian localisation (special thanks to @severeniys): [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=2810284852] Rus Perevod [/url]

[h1]- Compatibility -[/h1]
My top priority is always to ensure compatibility. No vanilla game files or data have been altered, the files of this mod are completely independent. Feel free to run with other mods.

[h1]- Recommended Mods -[/h1]
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1590362799] Dynamic Difficulty - Ultimate Customization [/url]
Looking for a bigger punching bag? With this mod, you have the ability to modify the strength of AI empires, crises, and any other factions at any point in the game.
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1623423360] UI Overhaul Dynamic [/url]
Amazing UI enhancements.
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1899061789] 3D Fleet Formation [/url]
This mod is incredibly helpful as it expands the spacing between ships on a 3D scale to prevent collisions. 

[h1]- Q & A -[/h1]
Q: Will AI empires use this mod?
A: Yes, AI empires have complete access to all the features offered by this mod; however, they tend to be cumbersome and inefficient with utilizing its contents. If you are hesitant to grant AI such power, you can choose the cheat patch:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1374229669] Ultimate Technologies (Restriction Break) [/url].

Q: Is this mod save friendly?
A: Absolutely, please feel free to load it into your saves whenever you like.

[h1]- Final -[/h1]
If you like this mod, please give it a thumbs up. Or even more, click the "Favorite" button. Those are the best way to support me. Hope you enjoy this mod, and have an amazing time!

[h1]Special thanks[/h1]
@Mr. Miyagi for helped me with some of descriptions.
@mario0244 for the new scripts which improved the districts replacing.

title: Trait Diversity
description:
[img]https://imgur.com/FPaS7X9.png[/img]
This mod adds 220 new species traits to the game:
[list] [h1]■ 169 Biological Traits[/h1]
[list] [*] 113 common traits
[*] 46 non-lithoids only
[*] 10 lithoids only
[/list]

[h1]■ 51 Robotic Traits[/h1]
[list] [*] 33 common traits
[*] 7 robots only
[*] 11 machines only
[/list] [/list]


[img]https://imgur.com/Hszt1bo.png[/img]
The mod contains some origin traits which cannot be added or removed after the start of the game. The traits will provide very distinctive attributes/backgrounds for the species and some of them may alter the gameplay remarkably. They are indicated as blue icons.


[img]https://imgur.com/i2DS3mz.png[/img]
[list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1934610438]Trait Points Traits[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2605304587]Species Privileges[/url]
[/list]


[h1]Other Compatibility Issue[/h1]
Note that the mod manipulates and overrides vanilla elements of: 
[list] 
[*] (game_rules) pop_group_has_random_ethics
[*] (game_rules) species_has_happiness
[/list]
I believe these are quite few changes, the mod should be compatible with most other mods.


[img]https://imgur.com/s12smZ1.png[/img]
[list] [*] English
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2506141839]Korean[/url]

[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2967751786]Italian[/url] by [b]Rahl81[/b]
[/list]


[img]https://imgur.com/uA5NgDR.png[/img]

title: Ancient Empire 2.2 [Stellaris 4.4]
description:
[h1]Stellaris 4.4.* Compatible[/h1]
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
  Ancient Empire Mod is a late-game/end-game event mod that introduces the story of an ancient civilization that was once mighty but eventually fall for unknown reasons, a series of related technologies, ships, and event mechanics.

  In the distant past, there was a mighty civilization, its influence once spread throughout the stars, but there was no unbroken feast in the world, and the ancient civilization eventually disappeared in a long time. After exploring ancient ruins, discovering lost artifacts, collating the research results of predecessors and even contacting the remnants of that distant era, the long-forgotten history of the galaxy gradually becomes known. Along with the story of the ancient civilization, is their technologies that were once developed, and the creations based on those technologies. Will these ancient and advanced technologies lead us into a new era, or will they bring terrible disasters to our galaxy? Only the time will tell us.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Introduced a series of long event chains based on [b]late-game/end-game environment[/b], with challenging enemies and related technologies, ships, and more. The ships involved in the event have independent models, textures, effects, and component icons, and have unique combat mechanics that are different from the vanilla.
[*]Introduced a shipset with this mod's theme, which can be selected at the beginning of the game, without using other content of this mod, shipset is compatible with NSC.
[*]Events Introduced by this mod have a unique [b]dark red UI and a special font[/b] that is more visually recognizable. The events added in this mod require player to [b]actively trigger[/b], which usually starts with the excavation of archaeological sites, and the player is free to decide when to start the event chains.
[*]Content Introduced by this mod can be configured through the [b]settings menu[/b] (usually in the Edict frame), allowing the settings to be adjusted at [b]any time[/b], which can control the strength of this mod's content ([b]this affects both the hostile forces in this mod and the rewards that player acquired from this mod[/b]), the earliest trigger time of the mod content, etc.
[/list]

[h1]Contents[/h1]
  Completion of one event chain does not affect the playability of the content of other event chains except in special cases, but because the difficulty of different event chains is different, completing these event chains in different order may differ in difficulty.
[list]
[*][b]Primitive Civilizations[/b]: Some strange primitive civilizations scattered in galaxy, whose world has high-tech relics that do not match their technological level, may be related to the long-lost ancient civilization. [u]This event chain is a precursor to the subsequent event chain of this mod.[/u]
[*][b]Alpha Area[/b]: Ringworld witness the last time of an ancient civilization in the galaxy, ancient technologies and histories preserved in it.
[*][b]Beta Area[/b]: An ancient psionic research facility that was closed due to an accident, and there are still some ancient artifacts and psionic research results from that era storaged in it.
[*][b]Gamma Area[/b]: A large damaged station and a ringworld full of production facilities located in this empty space, containing the equipment, supplies and security forces needed for the expeditions of the ancient civilization.
[*][b]Delta Area[/b]: An engineering experiment base of the ancient civilization, the long-abandoned ringworld preserves materials that have not yet been destroyed, and the surrounding space is scattered with many remains left by experiments.
[*][b]Epsilon Area[/b]: A station with powerful shield stands alone in an empty space, and the defenses of the fallen empire try to stop anyone who wants to get closer, maybe they find something important there?
[*][b]Zeta Area[/b]: A quarantined area guarded by the defenses of the ancient civilization, littered with the remains of countless wars, the ancient civilization seem to be quaranting the area and trying to maintain the shield that cover the ringworld.
[*][b]Eta Area[/b]: An ancient transportation center, the remoteness of which makes some of its important facilities fortunately enough to survive the decline of the ancient civilization.
[*][b]Theta Area[/b]: An astronomical observatory that appears ancient to the ancient civilization themselves, which used it to explore unknown universe. [u]This event chain is precursor to the mod's events except for primitive civilizations, wanderers, and other small events.[/u]
[*][b]Iota Area[/b]: An ancient archive chronicles a bygone time, and its maintainers want to communicate with the outside world to trade the resources they need.
[*][b]Kappa Area[/b]: An abandoned ancient computer surrounding the star in the area, telling the history of the system and the secrets buried within it.
[*][b]Wanderer[/b]: An ancient ship that was launched into the galaxy beyond our galaxy a long time ago. It has a powerful defense system that depends on other structures in the galaxy. 
[*][b]Other Small Events[/b]: Series of short event chains, anomalies, special projects, including [u]Starlight-II[/u], [u]Tactical Support Ship[/u], [u]Advanced Colonizer[/u], [u]Science Constructor[/u], [u]Dimensional Obelisk[/u], [u]Extragalactic Exploration[/u] ... 
[*]More Contents Coming Soon.
[/list]

[h1]Language[/h1]
[list]
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]English(Partially Translated by Google)
[*]Other languages are in English.
[/list]

  Some localisation related Mods.
  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2888635321] Ancient Empire 1.7 Traduzione Italiana [/url]
  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?edit=true&id=3588772505] [RUS] Ancient Empire 2.0 (Intergrated into main mod)[/url]
  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3036093863] Ancient Empire Русский перевод (Old,  Probably OUTDETED)[/url]
  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2476160049] Ancient Empire - English Localization Overwrite (Probably OUTDETED for now, intergrated into main mod)[/url]

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
  Conflict with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1623423360] UI Overhaul Dynamic [/url] due to overwrited fleet_view.gui, compatibility patch is required.
    [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2458928927] Ancient Empire - UI Overhaul Dynamic Patch [/url] (Put below two mods)
	
  Conflict with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1887282318] Real Space - System Scale [/url] that mod scaled the system, compatibility patch is required to prevent your ringworld shattered into 12 fragments.
    [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2225465303] Ancient Empire - Real Space: System Scale Patch [/url] (Put below two mods)
	
  Compatability with other mods hasn't been extensively tested, but this Mod minimizes the modification of the vanilla content(Overwrited codes will be listed in the Mod directory), so the compatability with other mod(s) should be okay. 
  
[url=https://discord.gg/VFAjEMth6F] Our Discord Channel[/url]

[h1]Legacy Version[/h1]
[list]
  [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3477965262] [LEGACY] Ancient Empire 1.9 [Stellaris 3.14] [/url]
  [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3612286019] [LEGACY] Ancient Empire 2.0 [Stellaris 4.1] [/url]
  [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3686757394] [LEGACY] Ancient Empire 2.1 [Stellaris 4.2] [/url]
  [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3745445539] [LEGACY] Ancient Empire 2.1 [Stellaris 4.3] [/url]
[/list]

title: Expanded Gestalts: Forgotten Queens
description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/85HPEwW.png[/img]
[h1]Hive Expansion Pack[/h1]

- New Mainscreen
- 4 New Rooms
- 2 New Origins
- 8 New Civics
- 2 New Planet types
- 2 New Ascension Perks
- 4 New Personalities
- 4 New Portraits
- New Advisor
- New Sound Effects
- New jobs
- New events
- New districts
- New desicions
- New planetary features
- New unique colossus weapon
- And More!

[h1]Support the Hive by becoming a patreon![/h1]

I really enjoy modding and creating content for the community and id like to keep on working for you guys!
Please Help me by becoming a patreon or donating, i really need to sustain myself to keep on working, specially under my high standards. Hope you can provide some assistance and enjoy the mod!

[b]Click here to become a patreon:[/b]
[url=patreon.com/hivemods][img]https://imgur.com/aFb5lX3.png[/img][/url]
https://www.patreon.com/hivemods

[h1]About the mod and Credits[/h1]

This mod compiles most of my other mods into one Unofficial DLC, adding a background I created (with a base from  https://www.deviantart.com/skyrion/art/Hive-709300772), aditional room and portrait from Silfae's and Oskar Potocki ([url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=902526212]Link[/url]) and voice advisor from NotSoBraveDave ([url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1328104435]Link[/url])


[img]https://imgur.com/tbZIcHs.png[/img]

[h1]Overmind (Temporarily Disabled)[/h1]
[i]This hive is ruled by an Overmind, that control and manipulate Remote drones.[/i]

Start the game with all Remote drones Pops (secondary species) with Full citizenship, Drone living standard that are Extremely Adaptative
Only members of the Main species can be Leaders
Members of the Main species can only be Leaders
Can always Assimilate biological pops

[h1]Holobiont[/h1]
[i]This Hive is an assemblage of a giant living organism that hosts many other symbiotic species living in it.[/i]

Homeworld is a Hive World
Habitability preference is set to Hive World, making other types of planets undesirable.
Colony ships are more expensive, but will trigger a process for non-ideal planets which will slowly turn the planet into a Hive World


[img]https://imgur.com/0qakYwF.png[/img]

[h1]Biotech integrated[/h1] [i]starting civic only[/i]
[i]Part of the crew, part of the ship. The hive integrates themselves with their technology, making it impossible for other empires to understand them.[/i]

Your ships do not generate debris, so your tech cannot be stolen
Daily Hull Regen: 0.20%
Daily Armor Regen: 0.20%


[h1]Mutualistic Behavior[/h1] [i]starting civic only[/i]
[i]Mutualism plays a key part in ecology and so has this Hive learned to thrive by cooperating with other species from its home planet, now looking at the stars for new species to cooperate with.[/i]

Can establish Branch Offices without Commercial Pacts
Cannot use Unrestricted Wars policy
Cannot engage in Indiscriminate Orbital Bombardment
Refugees are always welcome
Can always Assimilate biological pops
Can form Migration Pacts
Can not Purge nor Enslave pops
Available Envoys: +1


[h1]Organic Structures[/h1] [i]starting civic only[/i]
[i]This hive creates living structures and space ships by metamorphosing their larva at will.[/i]

Start the game with Organic Ship set (Will override any shipset you select).

Ships, Buildings and Outposts cost Food and Larvae to build in return of reducedAlloys and Minerals.
A Brood Queen job added in every colony and every 50 pops
Brood Focus enabled
Daily Hull regen increased by +1%
Farmer output: +2
Miner output: -1


[h1]Parasitic Embryos[/h1] [i]starting civic only[/i]
[i]This hive uses other Organic bodies to boost their Pop growth[/i]

Allows your empire to Process organics, infecting them and giving birth to new pops of your Main species when killed.
Has the 'Demand Sacrifice' casus belli on all other empires, which allows Parasitic Embryos to subjugate them to offer Pops as tribute.


[h1]Autonomous Drones[/h1]
[i]This Hive allows its drones to have some sort of freedom and independence from the Collective. While still part of the Collective, it is possible to distinguish one from another and easy to identify personality traits on each individual drone.[/i]

Unemployed Pops voluntarily resettle themselves to suitable planets with jobs and housing within our empire
Diplomatic Weight from Pops: +20%
Pop Growth from Immigration: +10%


[h1]Focused Collective[/h1]
[i]Progress is impossible without change, and those who cannot change their minds cannot change anything. This hive has the ability to reconfigure its collective brain synaptic connections at will to shine in different areas of expertise.[/i]

Provides the Research Focus policy to focus and redirect the collective's priorities between Society, Physics and Engineering research.

[h1]Mycelium connection[/h1]
[i]The hive has a deep connection with space itself, it is interlinked with the very fabrics of space and can somewhat communicate with it[/i]

+20% anomaly discovery chance
+1 ship sensor and hyperlane range
+2 planet sensor and hyperlane range


[h1]Natural Attraction[/h1]
[i]Like bees are attracted to flowers, the hive excels at gathering food from Farms and Livestock[/i]

+1 food from farmers
+100% food/minerals from livestock


[img]https://imgur.com/jxej45C.png[/img]

[b]List of Modifications:[/b]
[url=steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1715190550/1626286205709295656/]Link[/url]

[b]Common issues:[/b]
[url=steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1715190550/2950377478183670855/]Link[/url]

Overmind (Temporarily Disabled)
This hive is ruled by an Overmind, that control and manipulate Remote drones.

Start the game with all Remote drones Pops (secondary species) with Full citizenship, Drone living standard that are Extremely Adaptative
Only members of the Main species can be Leaders
Members of the Main species can only be Leaders
Can always Assimilate biological pops

Holobiont
This Hive is an assemblage of a giant living organism that hosts many other symbiotic species living in it.

Homeworld is a Hive World
Habitability preference is set to Hive World, making other types of planets undesirable.
Colony ships are more expensive, but will trigger a process for non-ideal planets which will slowly turn the planet into a Hive World


https://imgur.com/0qakYwF.png

Biotech integrated starting civic only
Part of the crew, part of the ship. The hive integrates themselves with their technology, making it impossible for other empires to understand them.

Your ships do not generate debris, so your tech cannot be stolen
Daily Hull Regen: 0.20%
Daily Armor Regen: 0.20%


Mutualistic Behavior starting civic only
Mutualism plays a key part in ecology and so has this Hive learned to thrive by cooperating with other species from its home planet, now looking at the stars for new species to cooperate with.

Can establish Branch Offices without Commercial Pacts
Cannot use Unrestricted Wars policy
Cannot engage in Indiscriminate Orbital Bombardment
Refugees are always welcome
Can always Assimilate biological pops
Can form Migration Pacts
Can not Purge nor Enslave pops
Available Envoys: +1


Organic Structures starting civic only
This hive creates living structures and space ships by metamorphosing their larva at will.

A Brood Queen job added in every colony and every 50 pops
Brood Focus enabled
Daily Hull regen increased by +1%
Farmer output: +2
Miner output: -1

This hive uses other Organic bodies to boost their Pop growth

Has the 'Demand Sacrifice' casus belli on all other empires, which allows Parasitic Embryos to subjugate them to offer Pops as tribute.


Autonomous Drones
This Hive allows its drones to have some sort of freedom and independence from the Collective. While still part of the Collective, it is possible to distinguish one from another and easy to identify personality traits on each individual drone.

Unemployed Pops voluntarily resettle themselves to suitable planets with jobs and housing within our empire
Diplomatic Weight from Pops: +20%
Pop Growth from Immigration: +10%


Focused Collective
Progress is impossible without change, and those who cannot change their minds cannot change anything. This hive has the ability to reconfigure its collective brain synaptic connections at will to shine in different areas of expertise.

Provides the Research Focus policy to focus and redirect the collective's priorities between Society, Physics and Engineering research.

Mycelium connection
The hive has a deep connection with space itself, it is interlinked with the very fabrics of space and can somewhat communicate with it

+20% anomaly discovery chance
+1 ship sensor and hyperlane range
+2 planet sensor and hyperlane range


Natural Attraction
Like bees are attracted to flowers, the hive excels at gathering food from Farms and Livestock

+1 food from farmers
+100% food/minerals from livestock

title: Real Space - New Frontiers
description:
New Frontiers version 3.3.2

This version is compatible with patch 4.4 Pegasus.

[table]
[tr]
[th][url=boosty.to/annatar108] [img]https://imgur.com/ZEBNNJB.png[/img][/url][/th]
[th][url=discord.gg/tCpXcNs] [img]https://imgur.com/K3aIvKq.png[/img][/url][/th]
[th][url=vk.com/realspacemod] [img]https://imgur.com/dwMExTS.png[/img][/url][/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EjzuguR.png[/img]

The purpose of this mod is to diversify the planets and colonization, without affecting the classes of planets. This mod includes. A lot of modifiers, events, planetary, decisions, features and much more.

[img]https://imgur.com/nw21Wag.png[/img]

A subclass is a new type of planet with its own unique features. Each subclass belongs to a specific standard planetary class, but has its own unique portrait and appearance of the planet. In terms of game mechanics, a planetary subclass is a common modifier. But the appearance of such a modifier on the planet is crucial. That is, along with a change in the appearance of the planet, its properties and properties will change, and also a subclass will affect the appearance of other modifiers, not subclasses. There are three types of subclasses: normal, paradise, extremal and exotic. Accordingly, this determines the nature of the habitability boundary of subclasses.

Additionally, a new class of planets was added, a Tidally Locked planet class and 3 subclasses to this.

[img]https://imgur.com/7hf9vNT.png[/img]

These are various periodic events that can be directly related to subclasses and their features or additional events after colonization.

[b]Periodic events:[/b]
Periodic events are various events associated with certain features of the planet, and are recurring.
[list]
    [*] Global Heating
    [*] Drought Age
    [*] Ice Age
    [*] Meteorite Shower
    [*] Ceaseless Thunderstorms
    [*] Terrible Hurricanes
    [*] Dense Blizzards
    [*] Relentless Sandstorms
    [*] Persistent Drought
    [*] Coriolis Storm
    [*] Geomagnetic Storms
    [*] Ion Storms
    [*] Wild Hunt
    [*] Insatiable Swarm
    [*] Abyssal Devourers
    [*] Sea Monsters
    [*] Tremor Earth
    [*] Behemoths
    [*] Strong Volcanism
    [*] Aggressive Flora
[/list]

[b]Additional events:[/b]
[list]
    [*] Ancient Machin
    [*] Nightfall
[/list]

[img]https://imgur.com/NMVLeDA.png[/img]

This is another important element of this mod, which can completely change the gameplay of the game. You can disable these events at the start of the game.

[b]Planetary events:[/b]
These are events that will occur only with individual systems.
[list]
    [*] Collision of the moon
    [*] Fall of the moon
    [*] Orbit Reduction
    [*] Orbit Increase
    [*] Awakened Planet
    [*] Gamma-ray Burst
    [*] Space Crash
[/list]

[b]System Events:[/b]
These are events that will affect all the planets and objects of the system.
[list]
    [*] Star Evolution
[/list]

[img]https://imgur.com/3HQzilW.png[/img]

7 planetary decisions to disasters. These decisions will help your empire prevent a disaster or save civilization from imminent death. Decisions such as the Ark project have their own chain of events. Some solutions will become available for Doomsday origin at launch.
6 planetary decisions for certain subclasses and planets with other features.

[img]https://imgur.com/ft0gtBx.png[/img]

[list]
    [*]4 new technologies to prevent disasters.
    [*] 9 technologies for blockers.
[/list]

[img]https://imgur.com/2AojcdW.png[/img]

8 new origins (see attached images).

[img]https://imgur.com/d8hVOcV.png[/img]

All new mechanics can be disabled in the Real Space menu.

[h1][b]Expanse Events[/b][/h1]
Expanse events usually occur after the colonization of new planets and are usually associated with the appearance of new modifiers. These events will determine the nature of the development of new colonies and, in general, diversify the gameplay at the entire stage of active colonization.

[b]New Jobs:[/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/pPtSIDY.png[/img] [b]Pioneer[/b]
[i]These travelers, hunters and prospectors set off to the unexplored lands of new worlds in search of alien wonders.[/i]
[img]https://imgur.com/i4xxpBX.png[/img] [b]Smuggler[/b]
[i]These adventurers are engaged in clandestine transportation of valuables, goods, prohibited items, or colonists, bypassing government control.[/i]
[img]https://imgur.com/7yyK8ap.png[/img] [b]Opportunist Drone[/b]
[i]These drones are sent to the most remote places of the planet in search of new ways to survive the hive.[/i]
[img]https://imgur.com/NUlDQlb.png[/img] [b]Aberrant Drone[/b]
[i]These mutant drones have received genetic changes that cause them to move away from the hive and show signs of consciousness.[/i]
[img]https://imgur.com/Hf4PUyb.png[/img] [b]Scout Drone[/b]
[i]These exploration drones are exploring hidden areas of the new world in search of rare resources and knowledge.[/i]
[img]https://imgur.com/UixSzJl.png[/img] [b]Renegade Drone[/b]
[i]Due to failures, these drones have separated from the central intelligence and are engaged in their own production, stealing resources.[/i]

[h1][b]Resource Depletion[/b][/h1]
This mechanic depletes the planet's mineral resources. This is influenced by the age of the colony, the number of mining areas and some modifiers that increase the chance of losing resources.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/vREipmy.png[/img]

[list]
    [*]This mod does not support achievements.
    [*]This is a global addition to Real Space and you need to be very careful with using it with other mods.
    [*]Disaster events are not for the faint of heart. Already at the beginning of the game, your home world may be in dire danger. If you do not want to risk, disable this event.
    [*]Compatible with Guillis Planet Modifiers.
    [*]After version 1.7 this mod is no longer compatible with Planetary Diversity.
    [*]After version 2.9, the Planetary Exploration submod is no longer supported or used with this mod.
[/list]

[h1][b]Bugs:[/b][/h1]

If you switch between different subclasses of the same class of the planet, the portrait of the planet does not change, but remains as you chose for the first time. This is a bug of the original game. The report was published in [url=forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/index.php?threads/stellaris-visual-bug-when-using-set_planet_entity.1138451/]Paradox Plaza Forum[/url]. To attract attention, it is desirable to support this post on the forum.

[img]https://imgur.com/X5NbIWc.png[/img]

This mod will not directly conflict with other modifications with rare exceptions. If the conflicting mod modifies vanilla planetary modifiers or vanilla deposits, minor bugs may occur.

[img]https://imgur.com/8hXVs7X.png[/img]

[b]My work is completely dependent on your donations. I have a lot of plans, friends, but they will be realized only thanks to you.[/b]

[i]As of late, Patreon no longer works for me. I can only get your help through [url=boosty.to/annatar108]Boosty[/url] and am switching to the new support model. You can now choose which project to support. I will be able to start upgrading as soon as we raise the necessary amount. The good news is that updates will appear immediately on Steam and will be available to everyone.[/i]

[url=boosty.to/annatar108][img]https://imgur.com/TA1b8DC.png[/img][/url]

description:
[h1][b]———————————————郑重声明———————————————[/b][/h1]
[h1]本汉化为公益性质，完全免费，任何需付费使用本汉化行为均与我组无关。
亦谢绝任何将全部或部分本汉化与下属独立汉化模组之内容用于盈利或其他商业用途，包括但不限于收费或收取任何形式赞助的模组、整合包、修改后二次发布、AI训练以及游戏内付费墙等。
鸽组对鸽组汉化、下属独立汉化模组及声明内容保留最终解释权。[/h1]

[h1][b]———————————————重要通知———————————————[/b][/h1]
[b]由于人手不足，本mod在一个或多个版本周期内会不定时多次更新，如果遇到翻译问题导致游玩体验下降，建议暂时不启用本mod，等待更新[/b]

[b]鸽组QQ频道基本完成建设，欢迎加入，频道号：580z28c235[/b]

[h1][b]———————————————mod介绍———————————————[/b][/h1]

本mod为鸽组汉化附属，基于Stellaris游戏本体的官方简体中文所做的勘误。自贴吧汉化被整合入官方中文以后，我们陆续发现后续DLC的官方中文翻译中存在为数不少的错误或不恰当之处（比如利维坦→星神兽这种奇奇怪怪的改动），所以制作该汉化修正补丁。

本补丁由鸽组汉化出品。

本补丁包含：
对游戏中翻译不当或错误翻译进行的修正
对随机名列表中人类的3种随机名（地联，人联，罗马）的修正
对随机名列表中陆军番号的修正

鸽组原版汉化补丁本质上是是基于*原版英文*重新审核对照并进行微调后的产物，部分文本翻译表意不一定和原版官中完全一致，还请知悉。
鸽组原版汉化补丁本意只为对官中缺漏、错译部分提供替代和补充，不代表官方
与其他存在replace文本文件的mod存在文本随机替换问题，这是蠢驴的问题，尚无修复手段
部分新版本文本尚在审核当中，小概率存在更新不及时、未能与原版官中二次校对后内容同步的文本或是部分翻译问题（咕）
星座翻译如果可能，将统一为星官星宿翻译（如半人马座α星→南门二）
补丁专有名词改动包括但不限于：
- 星神兽→利维坦
- 都市星球→普世城
- 前超光速文明→亚光速文明
- 巨型构造→巨构建筑

感谢Stellaris贴吧汉化组&星海无疆录翻译组为Stellaris游戏本体中文本地化所做的开创性工作。

群星（Stellaris）本体由Paradox Interactive游戏公司开发并保有版权。

title: Ancient Cache of Technologies: Override
description:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]

This override patch intends to improves both the vanilla leviathans  and crisis factions to be more challenging  when using ACOT. It also contains some graphical changes to various vanilla icons to be more consistent.

[b] "We thought we were alone in this galaxy. We thought that the precursors were our final obstacle. We were wrong. Somewhere in the abyss, the new challenger awaits. But we are the Ascended, we will not fall, not to the precursors, the lesser empires and not these new invaders."[/b] 

[i]"The Contingency Has Arrived"[/i]


[h1]Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] Multiple edits of vanilla component and tech icons and/or names to be more consistent across tiers or to reduce duplicates.

[*] Crisis Improvements, all crisies will now have their own unique ship components. All balanced around ACOT final component tiers. Their ships are also improved, especially their civilian ships.

[*] Scourge Invasion Armies have been buffed significantly. Contingency will now uses Omnidroids over standard androids.

[*] Crisis now have their own titans (Scourge Queen has been upgraded to Titan-level for this purpose)

[*] Captured Queen will also now be a titan-sized, and will produce up to 60 ships, with more balance between small and large ships.

[*] Scourge will automatically infest planets if they manage to bombard the planets to zero pops before any armies arrived.

[*] Extradimensional Invaders will now count Dimensional Anchors when they are built. <<<< This is no longer needed as PDX has recently fixed it, but I beat them to it first, so I win yay :P

[*] Cybrex will now be more useful, as they will now create new fleets after their first attacks.

[*] Automated Dreadnought and Enigmatic Fortresses will also now use FE-Tier Components

[*] Vanilla Components will be automatically upgraded to new tiers, thanks to the override.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues and Limitations[/h1]

[list]

[*] This mod overrides certain crisis events, a conflict will not hopefully break the game, but may make crisies not spawn Titan-sized ships.

[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]

Their components are balanced around ACOT components, some stuffs are notably stronger/weaker. Contingency in particular, have almost exact same stats, just that they shoot red stuffs instead. BECAUSE RED GOES FASTERRR.

Not Responsible If you set the crisis difficulty too high and end up with crisis fleet in million firepowers.

[h1]Save and Mod Compatibility[/h1]

Requires: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1419304439] Ancient Cache of Technologies[/url]

[list]
[*] Works on existing saves,  but any existing Leviathans/Crisis ships will not be upgraded. Only new ones will.

[*] Overwrites various base game components, this function will not be compatible with other component mods that also overwrite them. (This probably won't break the game, and you can probably still use this mod for Crisis)

[*] A small portion of Crisis Events are altered, unless another mod make extreme changes to Crisis Events, everything should be fine.

[/list]

[h1]Credits and Special Thanks to[/h1]

- You are welcome to use the fixes I made to the Crisies in your own mod if you wish.

- Stellaris Modding Den Community, learned many useful stuffs there.

- All supporters. Your sacrifice against the Crisis will be Hak Hak Hak.

Don't forget to rate this mod if you like!....Or don't XD.

I have a section on Discord for my mods here

[url=https://discord.gg/CMjnnET][img]https://i.imgur.com/4Und3QN.png[/img][/url]


You can also support me on Patreon  [url=https://www.patreon.com/user?u=10674702]here [/url] atm since my family is having a little bit of financial difficulties.

title: Improved Space Battles [Balance]
description:
[h1][b]Improved Space Battles - expand your mid / late game with 5 new super-capital class ships, over 50 new technologies and 11 doomsday weapons - including planet destroying, star system destroying and anti-fleet super-weapons.[/b][/h1]

[quote]
[h1][b]Initial Compatibility Hotfix for 2.1. Sincere apologies for going MIA![/b][/h1]
[/quote]

Improved Space Battles (ISB) attempts to improve both the visuals and gameplay of Stellaris's space battles. This is the standalone balance portion of ISB and contains gameplay changes designed to balance and encourage massive space battles. For the best experience, use this mod with  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=692028161]Improved Space Battles [Graphics][/url] which focuses on graphical tweaks for more epic space battles. [b]This mod is designed for long games in huge (1000+) star galaxies. However you can lower the mod's difficulty for smaller galaxies through Empire policies.[/b]

Improved Space Battles is a mod that aims to : Speed up the early game. Encourage strategic wars in mid game by allowing players to build defenses that limit an enemy fleet's ability to just FTL past their entire border. Set up the end game for massive battles with other empires and galactic invaders. It also modifies fleet AI to make large battles less of a melee brawl.

Fallen empires, crisis events (ED Invaders, swarm, AI) and other end-game challenges are all massively buffed to ensure the game remains challenging and fun. Weapons overhauled to improve balance. Defensive stations HP/Armour greatly buffed and maintenance reduced to allow for more strategy during wars - beyond blind aggression. A ton more changes, full list in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/changelog/693447055][u][b]change log[/b][/u][/url].

[quote]
[h1][b][u]IMPORTANT - You can adjust the difficulty of crises / FEs / AEs / Guardians at any point in the game through empire policies. Type free_policies into the console to freely change policies without a cooldown.[/u][/b][/h1]
[/quote]

[quote]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=720237457] Doomsday Weapons & Ships [/url][/b][/h1]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1085064499] NSC Compatibility Patch [/url]

[/quote]
[quote]

[url=http://gfycat.com/IncompleteBarrenFly]Ragnarok[/url]
[url=https://streamable.com/fw13]Firing the Spear of Cassius[/url]

[url=https://gfycat.com/VagueHarshAmericanshorthair]Erebus, Super-Carrier[/url]
[b][url=https://gfycat.com/TemptingRewardingBelugawhale]Micro Jumping[/url][/b](add-on mod linked at bottom)

[url=https://gfycat.com/PoliteAbsoluteBovine]Avatar destroying a planet[/url]
[url=https://gfycat.com/SaltyEnviousAmericanwigeon]Avatar blown up[/url]

[url=https://gfycat.com/ValidEducatedBaiji]Destroying a star system[/url]
[url=https://gfycat.com/MeekDependableHammerkop]Epic Space Battle (Full video in gallery above)[/url]
[url=https://gfycat.com/WelllitAcidicJohndory]2 Titans vs 10 Battleships[/url]
[url=http://imgur.com/a/S9LLU]Leviathan Gallery[/url]
[/b]
[/quote]
[quote]
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Buffed Unbidden fleets.
[*] Unbidden now spawns approximately 10 years earlier.
[*] Unbidden still bugs out does not make use of all available constructors.
[*] Unbidden is still balanced as a "starter crisis". 

[*] Greatly buffed Prethoryn Swarm fleets.
[*] Fixed bug with Swarm planet infestation.
[*] The Swarm now receives reinforcements based on number of planets controlled.
[*] You now have approximately 12-20 years to build up a defensive position after the breach points have been identified.

[*] Buffed Fallen Empire fleets with several surprises.
[/list]

[b]Weapon Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] All XL weapons now have 100% accuracy.
[*] XL weapon mineral costs increased ( +50% for T1 and +100% for T2)
[*] Mega / Giga Cannon, Particle / Tachyon Lance : Weapon cooldown increased by 100%. +200% damage. An overall 50% damage boost. Cannon range decreased to 105, Lance range increased to 120.
[*] Arc Emitters : +50% damage.
[*] Torpedoes : Range reduced to 40. Now ignores 100% shields and 80% armour. +25% damage. 
[*] Energy Torpedoes : Now ignores 30% armour.
[*] Plasma : Range reduced to 35/45/55
[*] Lasers: Range increased to 40/55/80. Now deals -10% shield damage (down from -20%)
[*] Matter Disintegrators : +10% accuracy
[*] Scourge Missiles : Now deals +33% shield damage and ignores 40% armour.
[/list]

[b]Ship Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Combat speed of all ships reduced so weapon range is now slightly more important.
[*] Corvettes : +5 evasion. -60% shield regen.
[*] Destroyers : +5 evasion. -40% shield regen. +40% shields/hp
[*] Cruisers : -20% shield regen. +40% shields/hp
[*] Battleship : +50% shields/hp
[*] Defense stations : +300% base armour, +200% base hp.
[*] Added aux modules for space stations that boost sensor range.
[/list]

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] All FEs now spawn with 2 Titans.
[*] FE / Crisis ships have been buffed.
[*] Guardians now grow stronger with time.
[/list]

[h1]Attribution[/h1]
[list]
[*] Glassed planet textures modified from planet textures created by RobertSteinIII (freebitmaps) under CC 3.0
[/list]
[/quote]
Comments, suggestions and feedback will be greatly appreciated!

It is recommended to start a new game after installing the mod.

title: Star Wars: A Galaxy Divided
description:
[h1]**[b]Star Wars: Fallen Republic is now out for your Star Wars itch. I no longer have the time to update this mod.[/b]**[/h1]

If you wish to play this mod on an older version, follow this link as previously posted by some other players.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/281990/discussions/0/1732087825007991514/ 

[quote]This mod will never be remade into a version compatible for 2.0, at least not by me.  To update it would require hours of work taken away from refining the new mod which would be then made pointless by the release of said mod. 

I'm not a game developper, I did this mod almost all by myself and learned all the code from scratch. I created it for fun, and as cold as it may sound, I owe nothing to anyone here. I simply don't have the time to dedicate to perfect it the way I envisioned. But, with the new team, we can release something that feels far more complete. You'll simply have to wait.[/quote]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=775990801][b]Suggested Mod Package[/b][/url](Outdated)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/V3Z5O15.png[/img]

A Star Wars total conversion mod. Note that the current version should still be considered an unpolished.
[list][*]Static galaxy containing approximately 950 systems.

title: Even More Origins
description:
Federations brought us the fancy new Origin system! You want more?
- I've got you covered: This mod adds [b]Even More Origins[/b] to the number of vanilla ones!

[h1]Origin Description & Features[/h1]
Below is a list of all included Origins, describing their features. Due to the steam workshop character limit I had to drop the flavorful background stories, but you should definitely check them all out in game!

[h2]Back to the Future[/h2]
Start in a maximum sized Trinary System on a size 26 Relic World orbited by two Relic Moons (size 1 and 11). Your species has the Relic World Habitability.

[h2]Ecosystem Integration[/h2]
Start on a Hive World.

[h2]Eldest Sibling[/h2]
Start with up to two primitive civilizations in your home system. At the start of the game you can choose whether to spawn one or two primitive civilizations and if they're of your own species or randomly generated ones.

[h2]Endeavour to Enlightenment[/h2]
Your leaders have a 20% chance to retain their level. Their leader experience gain is increased by 200%, and your effective councilor skill is increased by 2 as well. Agendas progress 20% faster and last 20% longer. Your leaders have a 20% increased upkeep and cost 200% more to hire.

[h2]Fratricide[/h2]
Paradox had dropped this idea from among their planned Origins - so here's me rushing to the rescue: This allows you to start in a system together with a Tomb World. Funnily enough they did add a picture sprite for this already.

[h2]Legacy of Nine Suns[/h2]
Start on a size 30 home world that orbits a Black Hole. Oh, and 9 different stars are part of this system. 
Feast your eyes on this glorious home system! 
I recommend reloading a few times to check out different effects (depending on the angle it generates you can end up with different camera tints - blue is rarest). 
Naturally, living in the presence of so many stars is dangerous: The Superflare event chain will fire for your home world.
If you are also subscribed to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1121692237]Gigastructural Engineering[/url], then your civilization will have thought of building a Birch World around the core of the collided galaxy - and if you don't block it with other megastructures - you will be able to build it here, in your home system after taking the Ascension Perk.

[h2]Out of Sight, Out of Mind[/h2]
Start with a Subterranean Civilization on your home world. This gives powerful bonuses in the form of additional districts or some districts and powerful jobs at the cost of losing quite a bit of science income for a while. If you aren't careful, they might take over the planet. And you don't want that, do you?

[h2]The Chosen One[/h2]
Your ruler is the Chosen One, an immortal, level 10 leader. They will allow you to start researching Psionic Theory right from the beginning. Though you probably shouldn't do that as it would take about 72 months.

[h2]Walking On Eggshells[/h2]
Start with a Voidspawn growing inside your Home Planet. It will hatch and destroy your empire capital.
You will be able to pick how long it takes at the start of the game. Choose from options between certain annihilation at 1 year and the 'very challenging' timeframe of 100 years. 
List of possible options:
[list]
[*] 1 year (impossible, if you do not get a habitable planet in a neighbouring system - and the default ones are disabled by this origin / I haven't been able to clear this myself, yet)
[*] 1.5 years (slightly less punishing, allows you to colonize a planet a little farther away)
[*] 2 years (you don't have to get really lucky to be able to find and colonize a planet with this - build an extra science ship, explore until you find the first planet and go for that one immediately)
[*] 3 years
[*] 4 years
[*] 5 years (recommended, you have some time to explore, but will probably still lose all of your starting population)
[*] 7 years (recommended, slightly less punishing - you might even save a few pops)
[*] 10 years (recommended, if you don't think losing most of your pops is cool)
[*] 15 years
[*] 25 years
[*] 100 years (for everybody who would just like to fight a voidspawn without a particularly challenging start)
[/list]
The screenshots are from the 1.5 and 2 years options.

[h1]Future Development & Compatibility Notes[/h1]
I am still adding more Origins to the mod (albeit slowly), as well as working on supporting compatibility with other mods, so please feel free to keep any ideas coming my way! 
A specific mod you like doesn't work with this one? Report in detail, and I will fix the issue! Thank you for all the support!

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Only the latest version of the game is supported, as several Origins use solar_system_initializers and the mod interface has been changed for these with 2.6.3

As of Mod Version 1.5.1 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=819148835]Planetary Diversity[/url] is fully compatible!
It is now possible to use the "Eldest Sibling" Origin with a home world from that mod.
Any randomly generated worlds will also spawn using the Planetary Diversity list of normal and rare planet classes.

As of Mod Version 1.6.0 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1121692237]Gigastructural Engineering[/url] will allow you to build a Birch World around the supermassive black hole featured by the "Legacy of Nine Suns" origin (a new save game is required).

All of the added features above are optional. There's no need to subscribe to any more mods, if you don't want to do so in the first place.

This mod should also be fully compatible with almost any other mod (even those adding more origins). No vanilla files were touched. There's one small exception: I have overwritten the following event: [code]colony.50 # Allowed Subterranean Civilization to fire on empire capitals[/code]

[h1]Endorsed Translations in Unsupported Languages[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2977692167][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2076767296794399254/D50CD23603B38450350F836D9E5C7506F3D98CF8/[/img][/url]

[h1]Obligatory Footnote[/h1]
[url=https://github.com/n1ghthavvk/stellaris-evorin][img]https://i.imgur.com/0nVeF3I.png[/img][/url]
Looking for my other creations?
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1868834704][img]https://i.imgur.com/sbtUpRC.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2080968400][img]https://i.imgur.com/IBj3WfX.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2036087802][img]https://i.imgur.com/JCGnvng.jpg[/img][/url]

Thanks for reading the description, downloading & playing with my mods!

[strike][i]Don't forget to leave a comment, smash that like button, subscribe and hit the bell icon!!![/i][/strike]
